title: Director of Customer Success
description:
Passionate about customer success? Fast-paced and growing startups? Building a team?

RealRecruit is funded, profitable, and one of the fastest growing software platforms in collegiate athletics. Our campus partners span all FBS conferences including the ACC, SEC, Big 12, BIG10, and PAC-12, and we are expanding rapidly.

As a result, we need a proven leader that will own Customer Success at RealRecruit!

Your job will be to ensure that all existing and future partners are successful with RealRecruit. You will be responsible for defining, building, and ultimately scaling the customer’s journey from purchase to production and ensure that it is smooth and well managed. You will help drive the creation of our product Knowledge Base. You will also monitor on-going customer health and establish a cadence for interactions that ensure each partner is fully optimized on their solutions. In summary, your job is to ensure that we deliver value to our partners.

You can expect to often:

  • Serve as the liaison between RealRecruit and our Collegiate Athletic Department partners
  • Onboard and train new campus partners on RealRecruit
  • Manage ongoing needs effectively to drive high customer retention and loyalty
  • Drive customer adoption & awareness of RealRecruit solutions through education and continuous learning
  • Guide customer use of available knowledge base and online support tools
  • Monitor and manage customer satisfaction and customer health
  • Leverage third-party applications to track utilization of existing and new product releases

You might be a good fit if you have:

  • A passion for customer success and laser focus on providing customer value
  • 5+ years of customer facing experience in a customer success or account management roles
  • Have experience defining, building, and implementing a customer success process for another SaaS company 
  • Possess strong technical acumen, ability to demonstrate RealRecruit, understand and translate business and technical requirements to appropriate internal teams
  • Proven effectiveness at leading and facilitating executive meetings and workshops
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills - especially in the area of public speaking
  • Experience delivering and driving software implementation and adoption best practices
  • The capacity to travel up to 20% of the time

title: Director of Marketing
description:
Overview:

RealRecruit was founded in 2015 and is one of the fastest-growing software platforms in collegiate athletics. Our campus partners span all major conferences including the ACC, SEC, Big 12, BIG10 and PAC-12 and represent many of the college sports teams that you know and love. Tens of thousands of student-athletes, coaches, and administrators trust and utilize RealRecruit’s various product offerings including surveys, real-time reporting, and documentation tracking.

We need a proven leader that will own Marketing at RealRecruit.

This role will also dig into multiple areas of marketing but must be able to learn and understand the market where we operate, the buyer and their needs, and how to reach those buyers in a go-to-market strategy. 

This role will own the company messaging, the brand propositioning, and the product level value propositions and how these show up in the market in a unified and consistent way. This person will be the chief advocate for our various product features and their benefits and will play an integral role in the organizing of product launches and roadmap planning. As a growth role, this person will help to identify new roles within the company to further support the expanding needs of the business.

This person should be able to:

  1. Develop and measure comprehensive and effective marketing plans that drive visibility and demand.
  2. Lead and develop product positioning and messaging that resonates with targeted buyers by understanding our brand, customer needs, product roadmap, market trends, and competitive landscape.
  3. Educate both internal and external stakeholders about our product features and their benefits.
  4. Develop assets that support and explain the features and functionality that we have and share them with various formats and deliver value. 
  5. Participate with our sales team on calls with prospects when appropriate to provide deeper dives into the product.
  6. Speak and present both internally and externally to promote the story of our product.
  7. Coordinating with Customer Success to ensure the brand and product messages are incorporated into adoption and usage initiatives.
  8. Evaluate media and partner opportunities to further the positioning and reach for the company. 

You might be a good fit if you have:

  1. Experience working in a fast-paced and startup environment.
  2. 5+ years of strategic marketing, product marketing, and/or product management experience.
  3. Excellent written and verbal communication skills -- Must be a strong public speaker, comfortable in front of large, very executive groups, and a solid writer.
  4. Build and develop comprehensive marketing plans that incorporate objectives, marketing strategy, needs-based messaging and go-to-market for both marketing and sales channels
  5. Proficiency in content management systems. You will be expected to build product pages, optimize the conversion paths on those pages, and use dynamic calls-to-action to create and test buyer stage-specific calls-to-action.
  6. Exceptional ROI-tracking skills, able to prove what is – or isn’t — working
  7. Worked in a small, collaborative, cross-team capacity. This role requires you to work across functions and departments to bring the product to life. You are at the center of our entire organization, constantly interacting with teammates, founder, and market.
  8. Willing to travel 20% of the time
  9. A passion for sports, having fun, and competing every day

title: Elixir Developer
description:
Select, a leading US consumer brand marketing firm, is designing and building a highly innovative go-to-market operating system for world class consumer brands in food, beverage and lifestyle.

We're seeking purpose-led, results oriented technology professionals for remote location opportunities to help bring to life an exciting platform that changes how brands activate in market. The successful candidates will apply an agile methodology and simple test and learn toolkit to solving challenges as our application evolves in the market. Thousands of client users on the product allow a unique opportunity to iterate and make progress with both thought and pace.

  • Ability to write clear and maintainable tests
  • Good understanding of common architectural patterns and design principles
  • Solid understanding of modern web applications and API deisgn
  • (bonus) Experience with mentoring or pair programming
  • (bonus) DevOps understanding and ability to set up CI pipeline and deployment

title: Software Development Intern (Singapore)
description:
A product is only as good as someone's ability to use it.

As a software development intern, you’ll help in product development in a full-stack capacity. We are on a mission to create the best spreadsheet add-on the world has ever seen. Don't worry, you won't be alone in this righteous undertaking. You'll get one-on-one mentoring and guidance, as well as opportunity to be a part of a lean, early-stage team.

About Airboxr

We're quite literally changing the way people use spreadsheets today. Imagine all the pain a typical business analyst goes through to create an analysis where they have to collect, clean and organize data from multiple third-party data sources. We remedy that by creating an all powerful spreadsheets add-on that lets you query data across different sources without having to write a single line of code.

We're proudly a remote-first and hands-off company. As long as you can take ownership of your work, you don't need to work on a strict schedule. Our rule for meetings is simple. If something's taking too long to explain over slack, we jump on a call. We also don't believe in unnecessary daily stand ups. We'll all sync up once (maybe twice) a week to make sure everyone's on the same page.

Tech Stack

Our frontend is built with React and MUI, written in Typescript. Our backend APIs are built with NestJS (also written in Typescript) that talk to a PostgreSQL server, hosted on GCP.

You can probably tell that we prefer strongly typed languages and opinionated frameworks with in-built support for a scalable architecture. That's because we want to build a real product that scales well, not a prototype that barely works.

We love functional and reactive programming and only kind of like OOP.

Why Join Now?

We're in the early stages of building a revolutionary product, gaining traction quicker than we anticipated. You'll be working very closely with the founders and will get a front-row seat for this very exciting startup journey that lies ahead of us.

Also, we're also backed by Entrepreneur First.

Requirements

Currently studying computer science. Students from non-computing engineering faculties are welcome if they can demonstrate experience in software development through past projects / work.

While not necessary, it will help if you're already familiar with Typescript and React.

The following is also important, given that we'll be collaborating remotely:

  • Familiarity and comfort with online communication through multiple channels (Slack, Zoom etc.).
  • Ability to communicate thoughts and opinions clearly in written and verbal communications.
  • Ability to think critically and form opinions based on information available.

This role is open only to Singaporean/PR applicants. The role may be extended to six months for qualifying candidates to make them eligible for university credits.

title: Video Production Specialist
description:
Job Detail

The Video Production Specialist is a multi-disciplinary position within the Media department at Walrus Audio. He/she is able to think on his/her feet and solve problems large and small while maintaining a stellar attitude. As a writer/producer, cinematographer, editor, sound designer, and animator, he/she will be responsible for creating incredible video content that supports and elevates the Walrus Audio brand.

Working with the Creative Director and President, the Video Production Specialist handles all aspects of film production – editing, motion graphics design, visual effects, sound design and mixing, color correction, and encoding; all while ensuring the highest-quality production values and quality standards. The Video Production Specialist also assists with the setup and filming of on-location and off-site video productions: interviews, commercial shoots; anything and everything video related.

About Our Company

Throughout the years we have been inspired by sounds created by our favorite artists: the perfect breakup on an overdrive; a thick, punchy distortion; an endlessly sustained reverb; a self-oscillating delay. Walrus Audio is a collective of artists, musicians and engineers attempting to find the balance between art and performance in sound manipulation. It is our goal to make guitar effects that are as interesting to play, as they are to look at.

Responsibilities

  • Acts as cinematographer on a variety of shoots
  • Acts as an editor on a variety of projects
  • Acts as an animator on a variety of projects
  • Is a producer on the front end, ensuring that all preproduction tasks are completed thoroughly
  • Is a turnkey, end-to-end content creator for all platforms
  • Is able to function independently
  • Acts as a photographer on a variety of assignments
  • Receives Illustrator and Photoshop files; translates into motion graphics
  • Helps define and elevate the visual language of the Walrus Audio brand
  • Produces/shoots/edits product demos, live music performances, social media videos, and other video products (which are always evolving)
  • Meets deadlines while maintaining a high creative standard
  • Works with outside crew members on bigger shoots
  • Helps generate solutions for video-related problems, large and small
  • Meets ad-hoc request of the president

Personal and Organizational Skills

  • Highly organized; able to build a custom workflow for tracking projects, jobs, and deliverables from the initial idea to the final archival
  • Is easy to work with, and able to maintain a positive attitude in fluid situations. Flexible under pressure.
  • Excellent multi-tasking and self-management skills, and also able to take direction and constructive feedback
  • Possesses a deep understanding of and passion for all modern media platforms, and how to craft content that will perform best for each one
  • Independent worker; someone that can have a “see a need, fill a need” type of mindset

*Additional Skills and Responsibilities *

  • Strong PC and Mac general computing skills including use of archiving/storage, basic networking and troubleshooting knowledge
  • Fast learner, able to quickly learn Walrus’ products.
  • Experience and skill with modern studio/location lighting, grip equipment, and camera support equipment
  • Knowledge of and proficiency with modern video codecs
  • Proficiency in modern digital photography workflows and equipment, including strobe flashes, location lighting, RAW file handling, cataloging/archiving with Lightroom
  • Ability to produce a shoot, arranging for talent, locations, necessary permits/releases
  • Copywriting skills; able to turn an idea into a script or treatment
  • Compositing skills: rotoscoping, typography, animation, motion / camera tracking, and keying, etc. within After Effects / comparable software
  • Ability to lift more than 50lbs
  • Proficiency with a variety of photo and cinema cameras/lenses/support equipment, both as a photographer and cinematographer
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, with a focus on Premiere, After Effects, Audition, Lightroom and Photoshop
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule and occasional overtime when necessary, including show meetups with artists/concerts, and early morning or late-night shoots as specific scripts designate

Job Requirements

Bachelor’s degree preferred

  • 3+ years experience in an agency, production house, or other content production environment
  • Music Industry experience and proficiency with the pedal brands is a big plus
  • A passion for ongoing education. A fast learner, able to quickly learn Walrus’ products.
  • Must provide an online demo reel showcasing previous work upon applying. Applicants without a reel or demo work will NOT be considered.
  • Highly organized in project approach. Must be able to systematically achieve success
  • Knowledge of guitar and guitar related products.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Annual base pay dependent experience
  • United Healthcare Insurance plan available after 60 days probationary period.
  • $25,000 life insurance policy paid by company
  • Holidays are paid by company after 90 day probationary period. (New Year’s Day, Memorial day, July 4th, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day and following day, Christmas Day and following day)
  • Paid vacation after 90 day probationary period per year

title: Growth and Community Intern (Remote)
description:
About Airboxr

We are building the future of decision-science. We help non-technical business users make faster decisions by bringing them the answers within a platform they understand best—spreadsheets.

Imagine all the pain a typical business analyst goes through to create an analysis where they have to collect, clean and organize data from multiple third-party data sources. We remedy that by creating an all powerful spreadsheets add-on that lets you query data across different sources without having to write a single line of code.

We're proudly a remote-first and hands-off company. As long as you can take ownership of your work, you don't need to work on a strict schedule. Our rule for meetings is simple. If something's taking too long to explain over slack, we jump on a call. We also don't believe in unnecessary daily stand ups. We'll all sync up once (maybe twice) a week to make sure everyone's on the same page.

About the Role

You will get to work closely (in as much as social distancing will allow) with both the founders and get exposed to a wide range of strategic and tactical responsibilities. You'll get one-on-one mentoring and guidance, as well as opportunity to be a part of a lean, early-stage team. We care more about your learning speed than what you can do right now.

This role will provide you with exposure to various ways of acquiring customers for a software startup. This will include a lot of writing (a LOT!), communicating with qualified leads, engaging users on external forums, designing collateral for marketing, recording instructional videos, and maintaining our social media voice. From time to time, you will be expected to get on customer interviews to understand how we may help them further.

Along with demonstrably strong writing skills, you will need to have an eye for data, an early ability to distill data into insights, and comfort with working on spreadsheets. Finally, after spending time acquainting yourself with the product, you may be required to do demos with users and do basic troubleshooting.

Why Join Now?

We're in the early stages of building a revolutionary product, gaining traction quicker than we anticipated. As one of our first full-time hires, you'll be working very closely with the founders and will get a front-row seat for this very exciting startup journey that lies ahead of us. We're also backed by Entrepreneur First.

title: Channel Account Manager
description:
Gazelle Communications, a pioneer in the Everything-as-a-Service has an opening in the Sales - Channel Sales business unit. Our mission at Gazelle since day 1 is to both transform and make accessible the future of Connectivity and Communications - for everyone, everywhere!

The Channel Account Manager (CAM) is part of the Indirect Channel sales organization and is responsible for sales and revenue growth in a geographic territory which includes designated Regional Partners, Sub-agents and branches of National Partners. Our Channel Account Managers are expected to use consultative and strategic selling skills along with a strong understanding of the UCaaS industry to consistently achieve quota attainment as assigned by management. They are also expected to develop highly productive reseller and referral partner relationships so that partners become self-sufficient in marketing and selling our products.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Discover and manage sales opportunities with all designated Partners in region, providing accurate and updated sales funnel with current status
  • Provide accurate and detailed weekly, monthly and quarterly forecast funnel of identified and proposed opportunities to meet or exceed quota requirements, in Salesforce
  • Manage and execution of Partner planning document
  • Develop territory plan, including documenting recruiting strategy
  • Meet with Partners, participate in joint sales calls to customers and assist the Partner in closing opportunities
  • An in-depth knowledge of the features and benefits and requirements of all Alliances routes to market and the ability to articulate it to Partners along with the value proposition
  • Assist Partners in broadening their product expertise and sales opportunities, striving for growth from all associated selling resources
  • Train partners on product, processes, and effective sales techniques
  • Escalate any pricing, SLA or other issues as needed
  • Coordinate Partner access to Sales Engineering, Field Marketing and overlay resources as appropriate
  • Disseminate all communications and announcements
  • Coordinate local Partner participation in events and training
  • Drive product and promotions and programs
  • Attend Shows and conference calls, as designated by management
  • Read all communications and maintaining a high level of knowledge on all products, programs and promotions
  • Recruitment of partners in territory into partner program

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years’ of related experience in the Channel with Channel Partners
  • Experience selling UCaaS and CCaaS products
  • Proven success of building strong relationships and partnerships
  • Advanced understanding of company’s telecommunications products and network capabilities
  • Minimum of intermediate understanding of company financial measures and advanced understanding of telecommunications industry and indirect sales model

Having a high level understanding of the digital market space along with the ability to create inbound marketing funnels through all available channels is paramount. title: Content Writer (Freelance)
description:
Grizzle is a content marketing agency that helps enterprise B2B and SaaS companies create and distribute authoritative, actionable, and value-driven content. Our clients include Semrush, Pipedrive, Tide, CXL, and Web.com, to name a few. Our goal is to help them surpass their revenue, traffic, and brand awareness goals using a proven content marketing methodology.

About the job

We’re looking for talented content writers to work with us on an ongoing basis. We’ll provide you with a steady stream of interesting work, processes, courses to empower you to write articles you’re proud of, and ongoing support from our team of editors.

You’ll be given ample amounts of constructive feedback and dedication from our editors to help you become a stronger writer. This is one of the most cited reasons that writers have worked with us for years:

“As a writer, you want to work with people that get it. Grizzle gets it. They get the importance of good writing. They get that writers need a solid brief, space and time to work, and valuable (constructive, not negative) feedback. And that’s exactly what they deliver. More than that though, they look for ways to get better at helping writers thrive by—get this—talking to them. The regular check-ins are a wonderful thing. Being part of the Grizzle team is a wonderful thing. I’m a better writer for it.”

Clients have worked with us for years because we embed ourselves into their systems and adapt to their brand voice. Therefore, this role is best suited for writers who are comfortable with writing in different styles in-line with documented content guidelines.

Bonus points if you have subject matter expertise in marketing, sales, business finance, HR, or other business topic. We encourage you to check the FAQ at the bottom of this page.

Benefits of working with us

Over the last 7 years, we’ve created effective content marketing playbooks that help our clients surpass their growth goals. Our content performs well in highly competitive markets, and we’re dedicated to helping our clients meet their acquisition, sales, and revenue targets.

However, we’re not a content farm. We take the time to create high-quality content that’s full of unique insights and value-adds. We don’t replicate what’s already out there. Every piece of content must have a purpose. We haven't done our job properly if an audience doesn’t feel empowered by what they read.

If our mission aligns with your values, here are a few other benefits of joining our team:

  • Long-term and reliable freelance retainer

  • Learn about content marketing, SEO, and digital PR

  • Work on industry-leading and interesting SaaS accounts

  • Collaborate with talented content marketers and editors

  • Improve your own marketing skills

  • Access to our internal content and marketing courses

What you’ll be doing

You’ll create authoritative, long-form content that empowers and educates audiences while helping our clients meet their goals and make their lives easier.

Once hired, you’ll collaborate with our senior editors on briefs and drafts. You’ll be given the information and resources you need to create detailed angles and outlines for your content and ensure we go above and beyond competing articles.

From there, you’ll research and write long-form content that's full of detailed examples, actionable insights, and paragraphs that drive points home while closing loops and maintaining logical flow.

More specifically, you will:

  • Research topics and uncover pain points to produce angles and analyze the competitive landscape

  • Create outlines to communicate the logical flow of your narrative and help us collaborate with clients (this significantly reduces feedback during the draft stage and means fewer revisions for you)

  • Write engaging, practical, and informative content that educates, motivates, and inspires readers to take action

  • Share and break down examples and supporting imagery (screenshots, graphs, etc.)

  • Cite relevant and original sources when necessary

  • Follow client guidelines to match their brand voice, tone, structure, and preferences

  • Collaborate with the Grizzle team on each project via ClickUp

Content formats you’ll be writing

  • Blog Articles: Long-form content to drive traffic, educate readers, and convert them into leads, users, and customers.

  • Content Refreshing: Breathing new life into existing content with new sections, examples, and value takeaways.

  • Landing Pages: Product pages for SEO and other channels.

  • Email Content: Newsletters and campaigns.

  • Ebooks: Long-form guides that overdeliver on value.

We’re looking for content writers who:

You’ll work closely with and learn from a sophisticated content marketing methodology. If you want to improve your marketing skills, you’ll see how we create great content and rub shoulders with some known names in the industry.

We pay our freelance writers per project. You can find info on our project rates here. This can increase after several months of working with us and for larger projects (such as ebooks).

FAQs

What's the typical word count for each project?

Word count can range anywhere from 1,000 to 4,000 words, depending on the specificity and complexity of each topic.

What sort of clients do you work with?

We work with B2B and SaaS brands. Industries range from sales and marketing to fintech and remote working. Check out the logos on our home page.

What's the process to get started?

We always start with a paid test task with multiple phases, followed by a client project.

What content formats do you create?

80% of our projects are blog articles. The rest is made up of landing page copy, ebooks, guest posts, etc.

What are your content workflows?

We have organized processes that are mapped out in ClickUp. You’ll receive a brief, then work with our editors to create an angle, outline, and write a value-driven draft. One round of revisions is baked into the process. Our content marketing editors (CMEs) and copyeditors are there to support you, polish content to perfection, and address client feedback.

Will the content be ghostwritten?

95% of our content is ghostwritten for clients. There’s the odd occasion where we can attribute a byline to our writers.

What project management software do you use?

We use ClickUp for project comms (and provide training on how to use it) and expect writers to keep open lines of communication with us there.

title: Backend Engineer (Remote, Global)

About us

Runloop builds simulation environments for DeFi and trains autonomous agents to provide liquidity, manage risk, and discover trading opportunities at scale.

We are a fully remote and globally distributed technology startup founded by engineers from Google Brain, Coinbase, Twitter, YC, with experience in crypto, algorithmic trading, infrastructure, and machine learning. You are excited to transition into Web3/crypto and develop a deep understanding of the Web3/crypto technology stack.

Qualifications:

  • You have 8+ years of industry experience in backend engineering, focusing on speed and low-level optimization. (example domains: game engines, databases, blockchain node implementations, HFT, virtualization, hardware-accelerated computation, compiler optimization, physics simulation, rendering pipelines, etc.)

We appreciate, but don’t require:

  • Experience with the Ethereum development stack (e.g., Solidity, EVM, etc.)

  • Experience building HFT algorithms and infrastructure

  • Production experience with Machine Learning / Reinforcement Learning

About the role

Expectations:

  • You will write performance-sensitive code to run “whole-world” simulations of DeFi, along with supporting distributed systems, data and ML pipelines.

  • Our tech stack consists of Rust, Golang, Python, PyTorch, Nomad, Consul, etc. We expect you to become proficient in Rust and self-sufficient with the rest.

  • We don’t require pre-existing knowledge of blockchain internals, but you will have to dive deep into various L1/L2 blockchain networks and determine how to integrate them into our simulation infrastructure.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Performance-based cash bonuses from our trading business (Unlike a typical technology startup, our business model allows us to provide both equity and liquidity.)

  • Full medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Paid parental leave

  • Flexible work hours - we are fully remote and globally distributed

  • Stipend for home-office equipment and ergonomics

Why Runloop?

DeFi is becoming too complex for simple rule-based automation. As thousands of composable protocols come online, it will become increasingly difficult to evaluate risk, make investment decisions, test protocols, formulate ML/optimization problems, etc. We are building technology to tackle this complexity head-on, and we are in a unique position to discover and trade inefficiencies at scale.

We offer a science- and engineering-driven culture that values deep work, quality, and software craftsmanship. If you’re excited to transition into Web3/crypto, few other places can offer such direct access and exposure to the entire problem domain.

Runloop, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity at our company and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Open Role
description:
Our team is always on the lookout for trailblazing scientists, engineers, and strategic thinkers who are passionate about the science of emotion and the future of beneficial AI. If you’re interested in joining the effort, simply fill out this application and we’ll reach out if there’s a good fit!

About Us

Hume AI is dedicated to building artificial intelligence that is directly optimized for human well-being. We have just raised a Series B funding round and are launching a new flagship product, an empathic AI assistant that can be built into any application.

Where other AI companies see only words, our API can see (and hear) the other half of human communication: subtle tones of voice, word emphasis, facial expression, and more, along with the reactions of listeners. These behaviors reveal our preferences—whether we find things interesting or boring; satisfying or frustrating; funny, eloquent, or dubious. We call learning from these signals “reinforcement learning from human expression” (RLHE). AI models trained with RLHE can serve as better question answerers, copywriters, tutors, call center agents, and more, even in text-only interfaces.

Our goal is to enable a future in which technology draws on an understanding of human emotional expression to better serve human goals. As part of our mission, we also conduct groundbreaking scientific research, publish in leading scientific journals like Nature, and support a non-profit, The Hume Initiative, that has released the first concrete ethical guidelines for empathic AI (www.thehumeinitiative.org). You can learn more about us on our website (https://hume.ai/) and read about us in Axios and The Washington Post.

The work is flexible, and compensated at a rate of $120/hour.

Moderators are only onboarded after being matched to a study.

Culture

Hear Me Out is a remote-first company. 

We’re small, and growing with intent. We’re here to build an organization; not a family, or a professional sports team. We love our work, but we also find purpose elsewhere. Life moves pretty fast.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Hear Me Out is an equal opportunity employer. We work hard to build a workplace that’s welcoming, inclusive, and equitable for all. That includes Black, Hispanic, Latinx, Asian, First People, and non-native English speaking employees; gay, lesbian, transgender, nonbinary, and other members of the LGBTQIA+ community; parents and caregivers, veterans, those living with a disability; and those who grew up without the privileges many take for granted. 

This applies to everything we do, including hiring, promotion, termination, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

We do not require a résumé or cover letter to apply.

If you need accommodations, please let us know at the email below.

Feedback

Hear Me Out welcomes feedback on our interview process. Thoughtful, honest critique will only ever work in your favor, never against it. If you see anything that can be improved, no matter how small, we encourage you to let us know at feedback@hearmeout.co.

title: Organic Synthesis Chemist
description:
PopVax is an Indian full-stack biotech building first-in-class and best-in-class vaccines and cancer immunotherapies using machine learning-driven protein design and relentless empiricism. We design, develop, and manufacture our own RNA medicines end-to-end because we believe great pharmaceutical science can only flourish in tight feedback loops that iterate rapidly. PopVax’s experimental work and clinical dose production is based at the RNA Foundry, our integrated R&D and GMP-capable clinical dose production facility in Hyderabad.

PopVax's north star is our goal of developing novel vaccines and therapeutics over the next decade with the cumulative ability to save 1 million lives each year – the Million Lives Mission. To that end, we are developing first-in-class vaccines against Hepatitis C, Strep A, and adult pulmonary TB; broadly-protective best-in-class vaccines against COVID-19, influenza, malaria, and HPV; and precision immunotherapies against hard-to-treat solid tumours such as liver cancer and pancreatic cancer. Beyond existing diseases, we are leveraging our high-speed platform to build rapid-response biosecurity capabilities against engineered de novo pathogens.

Our mission is funded by Vitalik Buterin’s Balvi Fund, the Gates Foundation, the US Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority (BARDA), Renaissance Philanthropy, and Good Ventures, with individual investments from Enveda founder Viswa Colluru and Tesla self-driving AI pioneer Dhaval Shroff. Our first program, an open-source broadly-protective COVID-19 vaccine, will begin a Phase I clinical trial in Australia in mid-2026. This is just the start – we intend to advance 6+ novel vaccine and immunotherapy programs into human clinical trials over the next three years, decisively demonstrating that world-class biotech R&D is possible in India. 

No matter the job title, each person’s role at PopVax is ultimately about helping bring safe, effective new medicines that represent a step-change over the current standard-of-care to the people who need them, as quickly as possible. If you are looking for a place where the ambition is high, the learning curve is steep, and the work matters to billions, you’ll feel at home here.

If you’re excited by the idea of advancing scientific, clinical, and regulatory frontiers of vaccines and immunotherapies, spending each day developing medicines with the potential to save millions of lives, and building a generational global pharmaceutical company in India along the way – join us!

We are looking for an experienced organic synthesis chemist to work on novel organic compounds, including lipids, nucleosides, nucleotides, and small molecule APIs, who is able to obtain quality results both independently and within a team environment with minimal supervision. The focus is on bench chemistry — the design, execution, and iterative optimzation of a large number of different multi-step organic synthesis processes.

RESPONSIBILITES

  • Design the route of synthesis for and performing multistep organic synthesis and analysis of novel small molecules, nucleosides, nucleotides and lipids

  • Perform chemical purification using a variety of techniques, including various kinds of chromatography

  • Perform analysis of chemical compounds using methods such as HPLC, TLC, NMR, and mass spectrometry

  • Document all experiments comprehensively and precisely in a step-by-step manner

  • Maintain a safe and clean lab environment while following all relevant laws and regulations relevant to the experiments being performed

  • Help the manufacturing team design and transfer scaled-up versions of synthetic procedures originated in the lab to production facilities

QUALIFICATIONS

  • PhD degree with 1+ year of experience or or masters degree with 3+ years of experience, with both academic and industry experience focused strongly on organic synthesis

  • Rock-solid theoretical and practical understanding of organic chemistry and structure

  • Demonstrated competence with the design and execution of complex synthetic procedures for de novo molecules, ideally with prior experience in lipid synthesis in particular

  • Prior experience with the synthesis of nucleosides and nucleotides would significant plus

  • Proficiency with software for molecule design and editing such as Avogadro or ChemDraw

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision

  • Experience with setting up and operating HPLC, GC, and LC-MS equipment, as well as analysing results from a wide variety of analytical procedures and machines

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English, proficiency with word processing software such as Google Docs or Microsoft Office, and an ability to independently conceptualise and write comprehensive reports on the state of ongoing work whenever requested

  • Experience with organic synthesis or analytical chemistry in a manufacturing environment, especially a cGMP environment, is a significant plus

We offer very competitive compensation, comprehensive health insurance covering immediate family (including pre-existing conditions), and, most importantly, a collaborative work environment focused on solving the cutting-edge multidisciplinary challenges of our novel mRNA platform.

title: Senior Software Engineer | Core Protocol
description:
About Berachain:

Berachain is a high-performance, EVM (Ethereum Virtual Machine) compatible, Layer 1 blockchain built on the Cosmos SDK. We're a young, world-class team of experts in computer science, type theory, economic game theory, risk management and enterprise development. Our team combines traditional experience in building and scaling teams at technology companies like Apple, Coinbase, IBM and Y-Combinator with crypto native experience from some of DeFi’s most impactful protocols.  We're all highly passionate about Web3, Toybox and building infrastructure to bring decentralized finance to the masses. Our core engineering team is based in Toronto. Here at Berachain, you’ll be joining a world-class team of experienced founders, engineers and researchers passionate about designing sustainable economic and blockchain systems. We’re well funded by a group of leading digital asset investors, hedge funds, centralized exchange venture arms and strategic angels. 

We are looking for self-starters and mission driven individuals to join us as we build the future of decentralized finance. The ideal candidate for this role takes initiative and ownership over their work, thrives in a fast-paced and highly collaborative in-person environment, and is capable of rapidly adapting to evolving needs as required. 

Requirements:

  • 5+ years experience in software development and relevant experience in blockchain technologies.

  • Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or related field

  • Significant experience in writing Golang programs with a good understanding of the best practices, concurrency primitives, packages go/* and reflection; and ability to write production-quality code.

  • Deep understanding of computer science fundamentals including networking, storage, operating system, data structures, transpilers/compilers, etc.

  • Expertise in systems design and an appropriate taste for simplicity, both in internal abstraction structure and in choice of third-party dependencies

  • Top-notch communications skills, clear written prose, and a knack for working with a diverse range of contributors and users, synthesizing different perspectives, and mediating occasional disputes

  • A high degree of personal responsibility and ownership: you’ll be responsible for setting deadlines and holding yourself accountable to them

  • Strong understanding of the Ethereum Virtual Machine, CosmWasm etc.

  • Experience with the Cosmos SDK, Tendermint etc.

  • Experience in an agile development environment;

  • Experience in setting up and working with CI systems;

  • Knowledge of UNIX network stack (TCP / IP, HTTP);

  • We especially encourage engineers that fulfill some of the above with no prior experience of working on blockchain technologies.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in creating microservices for such systems as Kubernetes, Ansible, Docker, Terraform;

  • Interest in the topics of proof-of-stake, consensus algorithms, decentralized exchanges, public-key cryptography, etc.;

  • You are passionate about blockchain, have used DeFi Apps and believe in the opportunity of decentralization and blockchains to change how the financial world works today.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Write high quality and well tested Golang code, following the latest design and development patterns.

  • Explore Cosmos SDK projects and other projects that will be built on the cosmos Write documentation, design flow diagrams and review

  • Creating tools for load testing and protocol benchmarking.

  • Constantly improve yourself by keeping up to date with the latest technologies trends

title: Process Engineer
description:
Join us in saving the climate by unemitting CO2; hundreds of gigatons of it!

About Unemit

To avoid climate disaster, emissions reductions alone will no longer be enough; Carbon Dioxide Removal (CDR) from the atmosphere is also needed. At Unemit, we’re developing a novel type of Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology to pull hundreds of gigatons of CO2 out of the atmosphere this century. We use a chemical sorbent to capture the CO2 in air contactors, and then transport the sorbent to a central regeneration system where the CO2 is extracted using low/medium-grade heat from concentrated solar. The process is highly effective, cheap, and sustainable.

Unemit recently received a large grant from the Breakthrough Energy Fellows program, and we’re rapidly growing our team to commercialize this promising new technology. Breakthrough Energy was founded by Bill Gates and supports companies tackling the hardest and most impactful ways to mitigate climate change.

The Role

We’re building our core R&D team, seeking a hands-on process engineer to join us on our journey. You’d own design and prototyping of our solid-sorbent regeneration system, as well as overall thermal and chemical process design, working closely with the rest of the team to demonstrate the full DAC system. Our ideal candidate is team-oriented, resourceful, curious, creative, and excited to play an instrumental role on a small team trying to make a difference in the world.

Responsibilities include:

  • Designing, prototyping, and testing the solid-sorbent regeneration system (applies low/medium-grade heat)

  • Working with the rest of the R&D team to brainstorm and ensure a well-designed full DAC system (including lots of whiteboarding!)

  • Process-modeling the integrated DAC system

  • Working with engineering services and suppliers to build a deployable system

Qualifications

The team is what makes a great startup, and to save the climate we’ll have to roll with the waves, inject creative brilliance, get stuff done, look out for each other, and enjoy the journey. If that sounds like an environment where you’d thrive then please apply to join us.

Requirements for this role:

  • B.S. and/or M.S. in chemical engineering or a related field; a plus to have a PhD and/or five years of relevant work experience

  • Track record of designing and prototyping thermochemical systems, and experience with process simulation

  • Passion for what you do, driving self-starting and strong work ethic

  • Creativity paired with attention to detail

  • Good communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Interpersonal skills facilitating effective and enjoyable working relationships

  • A positive attitude and desire to make a difference

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Data Engineer (NYC or Remote)
description:
We are seeking a talented software engineer with strong experience in data engineering to advance our core mission: using the world’s most advanced technology for emotion understanding to build empathy and goal-alignment into AI. Join us in the heart of New York City, or wherever you are located, and contribute to our endeavor to ensure that AI is guided by human values, the most pivotal challenge (and opportunity) of the 21st century.


About Us:

Hume AI is dedicated to building artificial intelligence that is directly optimized for human well-being. We have just raised a Series B funding round and are launching a new flagship product, an empathic AI assistant that can be built into any application.

Where other AI companies see only words, our API can see (and hear) the other half of human communication: subtle tones of voice, word emphasis, facial expression, and more, along with the reactions of listeners. These behaviors reveal our preferences—whether we find things interesting or boring; satisfying or frustrating; funny, eloquent, or dubious. We call learning from these signals “reinforcement learning from human expression” (RLHE). AI models trained with RLHE can serve as better question answerers, copywriters, tutors, call center agents, and more, even in text-only interfaces.

Our goal is to enable a future in which technology draws on an understanding of human emotional expression to better serve human goals. As part of our mission, we also conduct groundbreaking scientific research, publish in leading scientific journals like Nature, and support a non-profit, The Hume Initiative, that has released the first concrete ethical guidelines for empathic AI (www.thehumeinitiative.org). You can learn more about us on our website (https://hume.ai/) and read about us in Axios and The Washington Post.


About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced and motivated data engineer to work closely with our research scientists, machine learning engineers, and product team. In this role, you will help train, deliver, and monitor the use of our expression measurement, expression generation, and empathic foundation models as they are deployed in a number of groundbreaking applications. You will be involved in the design, development and maintenance of databases, analytics pipelines, and data collection platforms.


Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain data pipelines to process large datasets for both production and internal services

  • Conduct complex data analyses on datasets of user trends and model training data and report on results

  • Design new database schemas to store data for new functionalities

  • Maintain data processing jobs and systems to help improve data availability and reliability

  • Collaborate and grow alongside our engineering team


Requirements:

  • Familiarity working with storage and compute on a cloud platform (e.g. Google Cloud, AWS)

  • Intuition for customer focused development and prioritization

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills


Bonus:

  • Familiarity with machine learning concepts

title: Senior Product Management Coach (m/w/d)
description:
Als Senior Product Management Coach (w/m/d) wirst du eng mit dem Produktmanagement-Team zusammenarbeiten, um Studenten durch Unterricht, Mentoring, Projektberatung und akademische Unterstützung zu führen.

Für diese Position suchen wir Menschen mit Industrieerfahrung und Leidenschaft, um zukünftige Generationen von Produktmanagern in ihrer Entwicklung zu unterstützen. Wir suchen jemanden mit Kenntnissen in Agile Management, Teamarbeit, Zusammenarbeit und Führung. Produktmanagement-Generalisten sind ebenfalls willkommen. Die Rolle ist als Rolle in Teilzeit (30h pro Woche) ausgeschrieben.

Am Franklin Institute of Applied Sciences sehen sich Dozenten nicht als die Hauptressource für wertvolles Wissen, das durch Folien-basierte Vorlesungen an die Studierenden weitergegeben werden muss. Stattdessen sind wir immer bestrebt, unseren Studierenden Herausforderungen zu stellen, die ihre intrinsischen Lernimpulse fördern.

Aufgaben

Als Senior Product Management Coach (w/m/d) suchen wir jemanden, der folgende Aufgaben übernehmen kann:

  • Unterrichten von hoch interaktiven Sitzungen für Kursteilnehmer aus verschiedenen beruflichen Hintergründen und Fähigkeitsniveaus mit Schwerpunkt auf Teamarbeit und Führung.

  • Mentoring von Studierenden zur Unterstützung ihrer Erfahrungen in einer selbstgesteuerten Umgebung.

  • Beratung von Studenten-Projektteams in verschiedenen Phasen der Produktreife, um Anleitung zur Teamarbeit zu geben und den Lernprozess mit ihrer Projektarbeit zu verbinden.

  • Schaffung einer inklusiven Umgebung, so dass sich auch Studierende, die in der Tech-Welt nicht immer repräsentiert sind, am Franklin Institute of Applied Sciences unterstützt und sicher fühlen.

  • Beitrag zur Lehrplanentwicklung, um die Lehre zu verbessern, sich an Marktveränderungen anzupassen und sich verändernden Studierendenprofilen gerecht zu werden.

  • Beitrag zur akademischen Selbstverwaltung - stärke uns als Team und hilf uns dabei, unsere Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln und ständig an uns selbst und unseren Teilnehmern zu wachsen.

Anforderungen

  • Du bringst Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit agilen Produktentwicklungsteams mit und verfügst über ein fundiertes Verständnis agiler Arbeitsmethoden.

  • Deine Erfahrungen beinhalten auch die Bildung und Führung von Teams in einer agilen Entwicklungsumgebung, sowie deren Befähigung zu Bestleistungen.

  • Du zeigst Leidenschaft für die Entwicklung von Produkten, die Kundenwert generieren und erfolgreich am Markt positioniert sind. Dabei legst du besonderen Wert auf Teamarbeit und Führung.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Vermittlung von Kenntnissen und Best Practices, sei es durch Unterricht, Schulung oder Präsentationen.

  • Deine analytische Denkweise und Erfahrung ermöglichen es dir, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und komplexe Geschäftsprozesse zu verstehen, die auf verschiedene Kulturen und Märkte angewendet werden können.

  • Du verfügst über hervorragende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse und bist in der Lage, dich flexibel an sich verändernde Umgebungen anzupassen.

Benefits

  • Wir bieten flexible Remote-Arbeit an - komfortabel im Home-Office oder bei uns vor Ort in München.

  • Technische Ausstattung: Ein hochwertiger Mac-Laptop sowie Bildschirm und weitere Ausstattung für effizientes und komfortables Arbeiten stellen wir dir zur Verfügung.

  • Fähigkeitsentwicklung: Dies ist deine Chance, deine Fähigkeiten im Produktmanagement weiterzuentwickeln und gemeinsam mit dem Kurs zu vertiefen. Ein MBA im Produktmanagement ist quasi inklusive.

  • Übe dich weiter im Coaching und Mentoring der nächsten Generation von Produktmanagern und sammle so wichtige Führungserfahrung.

  • Attraktives Gehalt: Verdiene zwischen 50.000 - 65.000 € im Jahr in Teilzeit (30h pro Woche).

  • Dynamisches Team: Werde Teil unseres jungen und dynamischen Teams, das jeden Tag 100% für die Weiter- und Ausbildung neuer Talente gibt.

Wir am Franklin Institute of Applied Sciences setzen uns für intrinsisch motiviertes und durch Neugierde getriebenes Lernen für unsere Studierenden ein. Keine Sorge - Wenn du heute nicht alle geforderten Fähigkeiten mitbringst. Wir wollen unsere Zukunft gemeinsam gestalten und dir dabei helfen dein volles Potenzial zu entfalten.

Für jede Position muss auch Folgendes erfüllt sein:

  • Ein deutsches Bankkonto, um bezahlt zu werden.

title: Major Giving Lead
description:
Hack Club, a global nonprofit organization, is seeking an exceptional, mission-driven Major Giving Lead to join our team and make a real impact on the lives of high school students around the world.

As our Major Giving Lead, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of education by growing a network of high net worth donors who share our vision. You'll be at the forefront of our fundraising efforts, connecting with a global community of philanthropists who are committed to supporting the next generation of creators, problem-solvers, and entrepreneurs, leveraging your exceptional interpersonal skills to engage them through regular meetings and communication, and inspirational cultivation events. You'll be part of an organization that believes in the power of technology to unlock unlimited potential in young minds. With our school-based clubs, we provide students with the resources, mentorship, community, and real-world opportunities they need to thrive.

At Hack Club, we believe in investing in our team members' growth and professional development. You'll have access to a collaborative and supportive work environment, where your ideas and expertise will be valued. And you'll work alongside talented individuals who are passionate about making a difference in the lives of young people and building a movement that empowers the next generation of innovators and leaders.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive major gifts fundraising strategy that aligns with Hack Club’s mission and fundraising objectives.

  • Work with co-founders to identify, research and qualify potential major donors.

  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with current and prospective major donors and high net worth individuals through regular communications and meetings, donor-focused events, and on-going stewardship.

  • Create compelling proposals and presentations that effectively communicate Hack Club’s impact and the value of major donor support.

  • Collaborate with board members, staff and volunteers to engage major donors in fundraising efforts and develop donor stewardship plans.

  • Ensure timely and personalized stewardship of major donors, including regular communication, recognition, and impact reporting.

  • Work with Digital Fundraising Manager to maintain accurate and up-to-date donor records in the organization's CRM database and provide regular reports on major donor fundraising activities to the co-founders.

  • Represent Hack Club at relevant fundraising events, community gatherings, and donor cultivation activities to expand the organization's network and visibility.

Qualifications:

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in nonprofit fundraising, with a demonstrated track record of success in major gifts fundraising.

  • Experience at a direct service organization, preferably an organization that is focused on youth development or technology-based training

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with high net worth individuals.

  • Proven ability to develop and implement effective major gifts fundraising strategies.

  • Experience working with CRM databases and fundraising tools for donor management and prospect research.

  • In-depth knowledge of fundraising best practices and trends in major gifts fundraising within the nonprofit sector.

  • Strong organizational and project management abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

  • Self-motivated and able to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team.

  • A passion for education, technology, and empowering young people.

Location: The Major Giving Lead is a remote position, with preference given to candidates who live in Vermont. The Lead is expected to travel to various cities across the United States for donor meetings and cultivation events. 

Salary range: $80,000-100,000

Benefits:

  • Health, dental, and vision packages

  • 4 weeks of PTO (including 1 week during the week of Christmas)

  • 11 additional paid holidays

  • $2,000 hardware stipend (enough for a MacBook Air, big monitor, etc

Hack Club is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Deadline: Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.

title: Project Manager
description:
Hi, we’re Bunsen. We do creative work for science companies who are solving some of the toughest problems on the planet. Mostly, we help these folks be understood so that they can achieve their most ambitious goals. We’re creators who need the collaborative support of a client-facing project operations pro. Maybe that’s you?

Job description

As a Project Manager, you’re the glue: the main point of contact for our clients and the coordinator of our in-house team. Once our projects are signed, you are the lynchpin to make sure they are delivered smoothly — on time, on budget, and with high quality. You don't wait for things to come to you — you bring clarity, next steps, and accountability to every client relationship.

When it comes to managing client expectations, you’ll bring a sense of ease by always looking for ways to increase clarity and good feels while keeping scope and budget in line. You’ll be reporting back on the progress of daily and weekly tasks so everyone understands what’s happening. The internal team you’ll support sometimes need reminders and taps on the shoulder because they’re creatives and hands-on makers. Everyone at Bunsen looks forward to your playing a much-needed role by supporting the team to be their best selves — including blocking distractions when necessary. You’ll have support from us. We’ll be your biggest fans.

Role

Project Support

  • Own the overall project schedule both internally and externally and have tools up your sleeve to ensure that we consistently share this with our clients so they are always aware of where we are at

  • The main point of contact for our clients, providing proactive updates and timely responses and ensuring there is never a surprise on their end as to what we are working on and where we are at in the process.

  • Create space for the creative and technical team to do their best work by fielding and coordinating client communication.

  • Providing weekly status reports which include any risks or blockers the team is encountering and working to mitigate against these in a proactive manner before a thing becomes a thing

  • Ensure the Bunsen team is always aware of what is on deck on a daily, weekly and monthly basis. You are the go-to person for all things project process related.

  • Ability to succinctly capture client feedback and turn it into actionable tasks for the Bunsen team

  • Driver of approvals. Ensuring clients know when approvals are needed and the repercussions (budget or scope) of not hitting milestones

  • Understand and own project budgets. You understand the margins we are trying to hit and ensure that the right people are in place at the right time so that we are able to grow as a business against our project work

  • Are able to surface risks to a project early and often with leadership so that we can proactively react to situations before a client even knows a situation exists ;)

  • Manage retainer projects: implementing and managing systems for intake, scoping, and delivery; tracking and projecting retainer usage; proactively coordinating with clients to surface needs

  • Using and improving PM tools, workflows, and templates at the project level; identifying gaps, risks, and opportunities to improve project management infrastructure and sharing recommendations with the team

Overall

  • Seeing our work should be the best part of our client’s day. This role should be about making our clients feel comfortable, excited, and confident that they are in great hands at Bunsen, while keeping the work on track and running smoothly

  • Build strong and genuine relationships with our clients, maintaining regular contact to keep them updated on overall project progress, highlighting any potential delays or scope creep so that a solution can be agreed upon mutually

Experience

  • 2-4 years in an agency environment

  • Experience working hands-on on multiple concurrent projects and/or client relationships

  • Understanding of latest technology, principles, and approaches to responsive design, copywriting, info architecture, design principles, and web development at a high level, and have good taste! (kidding, not kidding)

  • Ability to successfully scope and estimate digital products (such as websites and decks)

  • Appreciation for great design and its ability to propel companies forward. Bonus points if you love science and the possibility it brings the world.

  • Comfortable with project and company financials — understand how to think about project profitability and how PM decisionmaking affects our margins

  • Personal qualities: Sincerity in and appreciation for self and others. Excellent communication skills — including sharing your own needs out loud. Emotional intelligence and empathy is clutch. Skillful expectation management, and great attention to detail are essential. Negotiation skills, staying adaptable, organized, curious, and an overall willingness to learn new things are table stakes. A great sense of humor or even humour if you are inclined toward English dry wit would fit real well.

Opportunity

Time: Open to full-time and part-time opportunities. We are remote-first but require ~5 hours overlap with EST.

Compensation: We welcome applicants from a range of geographies; compensation determined based on experience and location.

Think this might be you?

Please send your resume as well as your current bandwidth and availability to start work. Consider highlighting 2-3 past projects you feel align to our work (hint: delivery of digital projects dealing with complex subject matter).

title: AI / Gameplay Programmer (UE5)
description:
Level/Experience: Mid-to senior-level role.

Location: This is a hybrid role, and you have the choice to work from home, or join us in the office in central Brighton. Relocation and visa support is also available to the right candidate.

We are looking for an AI / Gameplay Programmer to join the team, working on our flagship survival horror game, The Lost Wild, published by Annapurna Interactive. You'll be instrumental in crafting unique creature encounters and gameplay features working alongside world-class artists, designers and programmers to help bring our unique game world to life.

You'll be responsible for crafting and expanding upon our game's core animal encounters and gameplay features, working closely with the Lead Game Designer and Lead Level Designer to fully realise the game's vision.

The Lost Wild features large natural terrains peppered with structural points of interest and indoor spaces. You should possess some level design sensibilities that align with these requirements, understanding how different spaces bleed together to support the wider gameplay and pacing from a design and AI perspective.

As a crucial part of a mid-sized indie team with AAA ambitions, your workweek will be quite varied and may involve focusing on an AI animal encounter one day and then having a hand in more general gameplay systems the next.

What the Job Entails

  • Distilling the vision statement of what our animals mean in our game into functional AI actors which exhibit interesting and dynamic interactive behaviour.

  • Work alongside game designers and animators to craft the player experience as far as interaction with AI agents is concerned, which may include combat interactions.

  • Have a hand in building or extending general gameplay systems in service of realising the game's core vision, even outside of AI encounters.

  • Responsible for the look and feel of animal behaviours, including fixing bugs, jank, and immersion-breaking situations in general, with support from our Animation Programmer.

  • Creating prototypes to help build suitable frameworks that can support and inform the design team.

  • Suggest improvements if necessary by designing and implementing new systems.

  • Collaborate with designers and animators in discussing constraints and establish the technical possibilities of AI behaviours.

  • Suggest innovations based on other industry-leading games and techniques.

  • Program in Blueprints and C++ in a clear and structured way, taking into account simplicity, readability, maintainability, and performance (where necessary).

  • Verify that newly developed systems meet project AI requirements and align with the game's core pillars.

  • Document the work so as to transfer knowledge and enable team members of other disciplines to understand how to use the new AI systems and functionality.

Requirements

  • Solid Blueprint and C++ programming skills.

  • Strong understanding of AI principles and techniques; knowledge of behaviour trees, state machines, EQS, etc.

  • Excellent problem-solving ability.

  • Self-motivation in taking ownership over your work while being proactive in your collaboration with team members.

  • Great team communication skills, especially in remote contexts.

  • Passion for playing and creating cutting-edge, single-player video game experiences.

Plusses

  • Involvement in a shipped game using Unreal Engine 4 or 5.

  • Worked at a AAA, AA, or ‘Triple-I’ studio.

  • Experience solving complex AI problems (navigation, turning, route planning, multiple agent interaction, etc.).

  • Experience working on pathfinding or AI movement/behaviours for characters, preferably bipedal and quadrupedal animals and/or creatures.

  • Strong mathematical ability; knowledge of vectors, matrices, and linear algebra.

  • Experience working with complex animation graphs, procedural animation, and/or foot and spine IK.

  • Knowledge and interest in mentoring and coaching junior roles.

  • Excited to be a part of an indie studio with big ambitions!

  • A penchant for survival horror games.

  • Into dinosaurs.

Benefits

  • A four-day (32h) workweek as standard.

  • Work from home or the office – it's up to you.

  • A genuine, company-wide aversion to crunch.

  • Private health, dental and life insurance via Vitality.

  • Annual salary reviews.

  • 31 days’ paid holiday during each holiday year, including all bank holiday entitlements plus your birthday.

  • Extra time off for special days/events or emergencies. No questions asked.

  • Fast-growing studio with good potential for career advancement.

  • Team meetups (always optional) a few times a year.

  • One hour a week of paid exercise and wellness time.

  • Annual allowance for personal and career development courses.

  • A flexible perks package – spend points on whatever you want.


If you feel you have something to offer this role, even if you don’t think you qualify for all the above, please still apply. We are an inclusive employer and if you have potential, talent and a great work ethic, we want to hear from you. 🙏

title: Associate Editor
description:
Associate Editor — Pirate Wires Daily Lead

We’re looking for a sharp, creative operator to work alongside our Executive Editor in shaping the editorial engine of Pirate Wires. This is a high-impact role for a high-agency writer-editor — someone with serious taste, a nose for the next big story, and the range to jump from editorial strategy to real-time publishing without dropping a beat.

Ideal for a former disgruntled English major who wanted to change the world and wound up writing clickbait. (You don’t need an English degree. We don’t care if you went to college.)

YOUR ROLE: As Associate Editor, you'll help lead Pirate Wires Daily — our fast-moving daily newsletter covering technology, politics, and culture. Key responsibilities:

· Editorial Strategy: Work closely with the Managing Editor to shape and execute high-level editorial direction, manage the pipeline, and refine internal workflows.

· Pirate Wires Daily: Manage our team of writers and contributors writing the best daily newsletter on the planet. Witty, irreverent, and a major growth driver for Pirate Wires.

· Writer Development: Source and onboard new contributors, manage relationships with freelancers and staff, and take full ownership of a major coverage vertical.

· Story Development: Help conceive, assign, and sharpen story ideas with the team — including the Managing Editor, staff writers, and Editor-in-Chief.

· Editing & Quality Control: Fact-check, proofread, and occasionally perform full-blown surgery on drafts to ensure everything we publish is sharp, accurate, and unmistakably Pirate Wires.

· Writing & Social: Pitch your own pieces, write when needed, and help program our social media accounts with punchy, well-timed takes.

· News Instincts: Be on-call when a story breaks. You’ll need to move fast and help decide whether we jump on it — and how.

· Trendspotting: Constantly surface the strange, exciting, and undercovered currents moving beneath the media landscape.

TO APPLY: Send us a few writing samples and at least two story ideas. We may ask you to draft one as part of the process.
