description:
The Opportunity

Are you excited about Eli but not seeing any open roles that fit you? Submit your resume!

We are an early-stage, venture-backed software startup building at the intersection of climate and fintech, tackling a hard problem in a rapidly transforming market. We’re backed by some of the best investors on earth, have a robust customer pipeline, and have built high-value strategic partnerships to accelerate our go to market strategy.

We’re growing quickly — let us know you’re interested in Eli so we can keep you in mind as new positions open up! If you care deeply about doing your part to address the climate crisis, this is an extraordinary opportunity to help build something special - and critically important - with a team of brilliant, kind, and dedicated folks.

About Eli

The Team

We are climate optimists who see the climate crisis not as a mere problem to be solved, but as the defining and enduring challenge of the next century and beyond. We are experienced founders, designers, engineers, and operators. Our founders have built together for over a decade, from helping to win marriage equality fights and presidential elections, to building vertical software for small farms and a next-generation mortgage origination platform. Most recently, they led a public-private partnership to build a “one stop shop” for Californians living in disadvantaged and environmental justice communities to access clean transportation benefits.

We know the climate crisis is happening now and great consequences are unavoidable, but we share a deeply held belief that we have the power to help secure a future where humans - especially communities that have suffered the most due to pollution and climate change - can live full, meaningful, and healthful lives on earth.

The Problem

In order to meet our decarbonization goals and avoid the worst possible climate scenarios, we need to dramatically accelerate the pace of electrifying our lives. Recent landmark policy wins like the Inflation Reduction Act could be game-changing by making electrification affordable for most U.S. households, but it’s still too complicated for most consumers to access those programs.

The effort to electrify 100% of U.S. homes amounts to a series of about 100 million small construction projects, and the plumbers, electricians, solar installers, and HVAC technicians who will do this work are facing far too many barriers to offering these vital sources of new capital to their customers. We’re going to fix that.

The Products

Eli is building products that make it easy for contractors, installers, and retailers to offer their customers incentives, rebates, and low-interest financing for consumer decarbonization projects. Think heat pump HVAC systems, EV chargers, heat pump hot water heaters, solar, and battery storage, among others. Our products are informed by years of user testing and real-world data, with an emphasis on supporting users with the greatest barriers to access.

Our Values

How we Work

Act and learn.

When faced with uncertainty, we encourage taking the best next step, even if that means presenting rough drafts or imperfect ideas. We stay adaptable and ready to pivot as we gain new information, emphasizing learning and growth.

Take ownership.

We work best when everyone at Eli takes initiative, contributes ideas, and embraces ownership over their work and Eli’s success. We proactively spot and address variables in flux to minimize unnecessary confusion. We don’t just identify problems, we take steps towards solving them.

Champion transparency.

We value clear, direct communication, and we are candid internally about what we are working on and why to ensure that we are focused on the right priorities. We are honest with ourselves about areas for improvement and take action accordingly. We coordinate and carry out our work as openly with each other as feasible.

Bias towards simplicity.

Being realistic about the complexity of our space enables us to understand and simplify this complexity in a way that our customers and partners trust. We know that there’s some complexity that can’t be simplified away, so we bias towards simplifying where appropriate to help us solve the right problem for the right audience at the right time.

Collaborate.

We value teamwork and mutual respect – both within Eli and with customers, partners, and other stakeholders across our ecosystem. Collaboration helps us build the best solutions for a diverse set of stakeholders by leveraging diverse perspectives and expertise.

Who we Are

We care about the mission.

We are building products that will accelerate decarbonization and make our homes and communities healthier, safer, and more resilient. We still have other motivations, needs, and desires - we’re human - but we have learned that we do our best work when we care about the people we serve and the problems we hope to solve. We don’t need to build a team of climate experts or activists, but we do need people who are motivated by the problems we are solving.

We enjoy working together.

Eli is not a family, and we don’t ever want it to be one. To be blunt, we think companies that seek to blur the lines between personal and professional are problematic. We want to build a diverse team that is connected by shared values, a shared mission, and healthy working relationships, not by a company culture built on shared interests, hobbies, backgrounds, or networks. We come from vastly different backgrounds, but we all make an effort to build meaningful, enjoyable working relationships.

We like our work.

This is not the same as “loving your job” - no sane person really loves their job all the time. Having a job means doing work on days when you’d rather not; it means having to accept other peoples’ priorities whether you agree with them or not. Loving your job is an unrealistic goal most of the time, but liking your work is perfectly attainable. If you are an engineer, you should like coding. If you are an accountant, you should like spreadsheets. We are attempting something hard that requires sustained effort, and we won’t succeed without joy in the work. If we aren’t finding joy in the work, we are proactive in identifying opportunities for growth, change, and/or communication that might help.

Compensation + Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: we use high quality benchmarking and market data to ensure our salaries are above the 80th percentile for our company stage*

  • Early-stage opportunity with huge growth potential

  • Early employee equity package

  • Generous health benefits (top tier medical, dental, and vision)

  • Flexible time off (minimum 3 weeks!)

  • Remote work or co-working, with frequent in-person gatherings

  • Empowered team members with minimal bureaucracy

  • Welcoming work environment where humility, honesty, and humor are highly valued

  • Flexible, family-friendly work schedules. You can work at a startup and take your kids to soccer, or help a grandparent with a medical appointment. 

*Note that Eli is proud to have a “no negotiation” compensation policy. We believe it is on us to do our homework, and work to understand your expectations as part of the interview process, and ensure we are offering a competitive salary for every position. A growing body of evidence suggests that allowing for negotiation exacerbates pay disparities and simply rewards good negotiators. There’s also evidence that women and people of color are less likely to negotiate. That sucks so we’re not doing it. We want everybody on our team to feel well-compensated and on track to meet their financial goals, so if you get an offer from us, you can be assured it’s the best offer we can make.

title: Physicians - Canada
description:
We are seeking physicians in BC, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba and Ontario who are passionate about helping patients achieve remission of type 2 diabetes through lifestyle medicine.

As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to work full-time or part-time (1-2 days per week) providing virtual care to our patients. Our virtual care offering is a full-stack solution designed to help patients make the necessary changes to reverse insulin resistance.

In addition to the 1:1 consultation and follow-up visits that you provide, patients receive an online curriculum with over 25 hours of videos, downloads, and exercises over 12 weeks. This educational material is paired with weekly group medical visits that you will co-facilitate with one of our registered dietitians.

We have a comprehensive training program that will guide you through the details of our approach and help you to be confident in delivering lifestyle medicine care for diabetes remission.

92% of patient in our program improve their A1c and 46% achieve an A1c <6.5%.

Requirements:

  • Licensed to practice

  • Knowledge and experience in lifestyle medicine

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Comfortable with technology

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team (physicians, registered dietitians, clinical counsellors and patient success support staff)

Our services are currently available in Ontario, British Columbia, and Alberta, and we are expanding our reach. Join our growing team and help us scale diabetes remission as an option for our patients.

About LifestyleRx:

LifestyleRx is pioneering the future of virtual healthcare, focusing on type 2 diabetes reversal. By 2030, we aim to deliver 2M diabetic remissions, return 12M years of life to patients, and offset more than $250B in healthcare costs.

title: Sales Director
description:
Sales Director

Amide Technologies is a Cambridge-based biotech company focused on synthesizing peptides that are difficult to obtain through existing means, bridging the gap between traditional solid phase peptide synthesis and biological expression. By using unnatural amino acids and artificial protein backbones, our team is expanding possibilities in peptide drug design.

Amide is seeking an experienced Sales Director who will play a key role in developing, refining, and executing Amide’s commercial strategy.  The Sales Director will drive engagements with potential clients and partners and will have primary tactical  responsibility to expand new and existing client relationships and drive revenue as per Amide’s commercial strategy.

The Sales Director will be supported by a team of functional experts in science, machine learning, operations, legal and finance. The Sales Director will have tactical responsibility for the company’s deal-making, provide leadership and frequent communication to the management team on market trends, and execute a strategy that will allow the company to fulfill its scientific/technology mission and build shareholder value.  This will initially be an individual contributor role, with the expectation that the Sales Director will ultimately build and lead a team of sales professionals as the market develops for Amide’s products and services.

Responsibilities

  • Sales Strategy & Growth: Develop and implement sales strategies to drive revenue growth, both within the US and international markets

  • Client Relationship Management: Cultivate and manage relationships with existing clients, and identify opportunities to further engage and provide value

  • Internal Relationship Management:  Cultivate a strong and effective partnership with R&D teams to evaluate potential new products and services, integrating a commercial perspective early in the research and development process

  • Market Analysis: Monitor the protein synthesis market to identify emerging trends, competition, and potential external innovation/partnership opportunities with academia and industry to expand commercial opportunities

  • Sales Forecasting: Produce regular sales forecasts and reports, tracking the sales team’s performance against targets

  • Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including R&D, Marketing, and Product Development, to ensure alignment in achieving company goals

  • Travel: Frequently travel to client locations, industry conferences, and other relevant events to represent the company and cultivate sales leads (up to 50% travel)

Requirements

  • BS/MS in relevant scientific discipline required, advanced degree and/or MBA preferred

  • 5+ years of relevant business development and commercial experience in Biotech/Pharma

  • Scientific and regulatory understanding of development of pharmaceutical products

  • Strong current network in the Biotech/Pharma industry

  • Proven ability to thrive in the dynamic environment of a start-up

  • Strategic and innovative thinker with broad business experience

  • Excellent leadership skills, with solid judgment and decision-making capabilities

  • Strong desire to work both strategically and hands-on as part of a committed and dedicated team

  • Solution-oriented individual with both high integrity and entrepreneurial mind-set

  • Excellent communication skills, with ability to communicate to a wide range of audiences

The position is full time and ideally the individual will be based at the company’s headquarters in Cambridge, Massachusetts, USA.  Flexibility with regard to working hours and travel is required.  The Sales Director will report to the Chief Executive Officer.

Amide Technologies offers a challenging and exciting role in one of the Northeast’s most innovative biotech companies. The company offers a competitive compensation package including salary, commission, and equity.

Amide deeply values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants equally for employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.

title: Head of Process Engineering
description:
Head of Process Engineering 

About Osmoses 🌱🌍

Osmoses Inc. is a technology company revolutionizing the way industrial separations are performed today! Industrial separation processes account for 15% of the world’s energy consumption and are responsible for 16% of CO2 emissions because we rely on energy-intensive technology. Changing this is one of the biggest opportunities to enable the energy transition.

We bring together a diverse and dynamic group of scientists, engineers, business professionals, and operators to develop and commercialize cutting-edge membrane technology that can reduce the impact of gas separations on the environment while increasing the economic incentive for our customers. Our groundbreaking separation solutions have the power to disrupt multi-billion dollar markets worldwide, reducing industrial energy consumption and accelerate the adoption of alternative energy sources with lower environmental impact. 

Join us! Together, we can create a future where cleaner and more sustainable industrial processes become the norm. 


Position Overview 🎯

Osmoses Inc. is building a Product and Process Engineering team to design, qualify, and deploy small- and large-scale pilots for the first Osmoses product line. The Product and Process Engineering team will work on process engineering, pre- and post-pilot membrane testing, and detailed planning and design work en-route to commercial-scale pilots.

As head of engineering your role will extend to the strategic management of complex projects, involving scoping, estimating, planning, and execution. You will work cross-functionally with the technology, engineering and business teams to support the development of the first product through engineering analysis. You will be responsible for guiding and supporting the team at every phase of the solution development process from initial system design through to planning and execution of pilot projects. This position offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact within a collaborative and innovative environment.

What you’ll be doing 📝

  • Managing a team of 2-3 process engineers to deploy the first Osmoses membrane pilot in the field and subsequent pilots or systems at increasing scales. 

  • Develop and maintain partnerships with system integrators and engineering, procurement, construction companies (EPCs) to deploy Osmoses first pilots and systems. 

  • Drive the creation, refinement, and integration of a compelling value proposition against incumbent solutions including drafting, refining, and consolidating the VP for publication in external outlets.

  • Optimise membrane process design to achieve product and system specifications at low cost.

  • Develop detailed flow schematics (PFD and P&IDs), build-out safety management tools, and create start-up procedures for membrane pilot and system deployment. 

  • Build out basic engineering design package (BED), drafting FEED documents and lead Hazard and Operability Studies (HAZOPs).

  • Support team in performing equipment sizing, creating data sheets, and selecting systems and controls.

  • Build-out accurate costing models for membrane systems through performing procurement with vendors, validating costing assumptions and creating internal costing standards.

  • Communicates with confidence and respect to customers and operators.

What we’re looking for 🔍

  • Background in chemical engineering with at least 7-10 years in the industry. 

  • Demonstrated expertise in deploying separation systems in industry and overseeing projects from design inception to operational implementation.

  • Experience scoping, estimating, planning and execution of complex projects including development of  schedules, cost estimates and project execution in the field.

  • Demonstrated experience with industry and safety standards, including API, ASME, EPA, etc., is essential. Safety takes precedence in our pilot construction, making it crucial to have a Head of Engineering with a documented track record of ensuring safety.

  • Ability to lead scope review meetings with membrane system operators and process engineers. 

  • Demonstrated experience in adeptly managing teams and vendors, coupled with a successful history of collaboration with Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) partners and system integrators.

  • Experience deploying membrane systems is strongly desired

Qualities we’re looking for 💡

  • Team player: wants to make those around them better and makes the goals of the organization their goals.

  • Accountability:  methodically organized, willing to report transparently on progress and collaboratively adjust approach when facing bumps in the road.

  • Clear communication: able to formulate and articulate data-informed opinions both internally and with partners/customers, verbally and in writing, based on research and experience.

  • Nimble:  able to adjust as new information surfaces in a fast-paced start-up environment. Capable of diving into a new business, learning and building expertise and credibility for the organization quickly.

  • Creativity:  willing to challenge the standard thinking with new ideas, new approaches, and new solutions.


What we can offer you 🎁

  • Opportunity to contribute to addressing one of the biggest environmental challenges of this century.

  • Work in the heart of the most innovative square mile in the world and the most exciting hub for clean tech.

  • High leadership and growth potential joining at a critical stage a company with strong momentum backed by leading venture capital firms.

  • Access to competitive salary and equity packages.


Our commitment 🌈 

You belong at Osmoses!

We are committed to an environment that provides a workplace of belonging, acceptance and safety for everyone! We appreciate, value, and embrace the unique differences of our team members, business associates, candidates and stakeholders.

Why? Because we believe it is powerful to embed diversity in all aspects of our business - it is at the core of our culture. Osmoses’ responsibility and dedication towards our DEIB principles ensures an equitable workplace with a diverse, dynamic team of professionals. This is fundamental to our mission to develop and commercialize environmentally safe, innovative technology that can create a future where cleaner and more sustainable industrial processes become the norm.


If you're excited about making a positive impact on the environment and being part of an innovative team, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and let's shape a greener future together! 🌿🌏🚀

title: Open Application
description:
Join us on our journey of re-inventing cement.

Cemvision is a growing company on a mission to decarbonize cement, one of the world’s most urgent climate challenges, accounting for 8% of global CO2 emissions. We’re a team of cement and electrification experts, researchers, supply-chain specialists, creatives, and innovators from the traditional industry, academia, and the hyper-growth tech world. We’re proud to be backed by Breakthrough Energy Fellows (founded by Bill Gates in 2015), Norrsken Foundation, EQT Foundation, Polar Structure, BackingMinds, and Zacua Ventures, as well as companies from the cement, construction, and real estate industries.

We’re currently on a journey to grow bigger and faster, and are looking for talented, innovative, and mission-driven people that want to be part of our movement to advance the greening of the cement sector by significantly reducing carbon emissions.

Why Cemvision?

If you are passionate about contributing to making a significant positive impact on the environment, we offer a unique opportunity to disrupt and help shape the future of the cement industry. You will be part of a dynamic and collaborative team of experts that is dedicated to, together as a team, creating a sustainable future for generations to come. We offer an exciting work environment where innovative ideas and sustainability are at the core of what we do and where your contributions will be a key component in our success.

Who we are looking for

To thrive in our environment, you should possess a 'no-problem-too-big' attitude and be highly resourceful. This means a lot of drive, an analytical mindset, and being motivated by collaborating with others and getting things done. Specifically, we are seeking individuals who are:

  • Mission-driven: You deeply care about sustainability and are passionate about Cemvision’s mission to decarbonize cement.

  • Thriving in a dynamic start-up environment: You need to embrace the unique challenges and opportunities that come with a start-up, and enjoy being part of building the organisation around you. Our startup culture is fast-paced and ever-evolving. You should be comfortable wearing multiple hats, navigating ambiguity, and quickly adapting to changing priorities and strategies.

  • Hands-on: You enjoy working hands-on in an open, collaborative environment, and actively developing the tools and infrastructure you need in your day-to-day work.

  • Entrepreneurial in spirit: As a startup, we value entrepreneurial spirit and initiative. You take ownership by identifying issues and actively contribute to finding solutions when things aren't working as they should, explore new ideas, and drive initiatives forward with creativity and determination.

  • Resilient and have grit: Building something revolutionary isn't easy, and setbacks are inevitable. Resilience and grit are essential qualities for navigating challenges, overcoming obstacles, and staying focused on our long-term vision despite adversity.

    We are focusing on expanding our team in Stockholm, where we have our HQ.

Cemvision is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We value radical open-mindedness. We take a people-first approach, and together we are on a continuous learning journey and value teamwork and collaboration. We are all responsible for shaping the company culture and seek candidates who identify with our culture.

Excited about joining our team?

We're eager to hear from you and excited to explore upcoming job opportunities that align with your skills and strengths.

description:

Our customers leverage Sona's advanced, account identification, attribution, and intent data coupled with industry-leading data enrichment to fuel business growth. As a Content Marketing Specialist, you'll write engaging content that captivates B2B audiences and drives revenue. By studying customer pain points through sales data and research, you’ll craft educational content that helps customers and that naturally intersects with Sona’s product offerings.

title: Lab Technician or Engineer - DC Microgrid
description:
Overview

Our electrical infrastructure sits at an inflection point, soon to be overwhelmed by rapidly increasing demand and aging, vulnerable infrastructure. Energy costs will continue to rise and outages will become more frequent unless we rapidly transition from our current centrally managed model, to a decentralized and intelligent grid.

DEP’s mission is to make clean, resilient, and renewable energy systems accessible to everyone by developing intelligent software that automates the design and deployment of ultra-efficient decentralized micro grids. The future of energy is decentralized and we're building the team that will make it a reality.


Job Description

We are seeking a skilled and motivated DC Microgrid Lab Technician and/or Engineer to join our project engineering team in Charlotte, NC in our DC Microgrid Lab (a hub of innovation and development of advanced energy technologies).  As a DC Microgrid Lab Technician/Engineer, you will play a crucial hands-on role in the testing, operating and maintaining, evaluating microgrid component performance, and aiding the development and integration of components into our DC microgrid systems. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in the field of renewable energy and power distribution.


Responsibilities

  • Microgrid Testing: Conduct a variety of experiments and tests on DC microgrid systems to assess their performance, efficiency, and reliability.

  • Equipment Setup and Maintenance: Install, operate, and maintain DC Microgrid laboratory equipment, including inverters, batteries, solar panels, and DC power sources, ensuring they are in optimal working condition.

  • Data Collection and Analysis: Monitor and collect data during microgrid testing, analyze results, and prepare detailed reports to provide valuable insights for research and development efforts.

  • Troubleshooting: Identify and diagnose issues or malfunctions in the microgrid systems and work with engineers to develop and implement solutions.

  • Safety Compliance: Adhere to safety protocols and guidelines while working in the lab to ensure a safe working environment for yourself and colleagues.

  • Documentation: Maintain accurate records of experiments, procedures, and equipment maintenance activities, ensuring that all data is well-organized and easily accessible.

  • Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineers, researchers, and project managers, to support the development and improvement of DC microgrid systems.

  • Inventory Management: Assist in the procurement and management of lab supplies and equipment, ensuring that the lab is well-stocked and organized.

Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent with minimum of 5 years’ experience; associate's degree or technical certification in electrical engineering, renewable energy, or a related field preferred.  Bachelor's degree preferred.  

  • Prior experience working in a laboratory setting, especially in the field of renewable energy or power systems, is a plus.

  • Strong understanding of electrical circuits, components, and instrumentation.

  • Proficiency in the use of laboratory equipment and tools, including oscilloscopes, multimeters, and data acquisition systems.

  • Basic knowledge of DC microgrid systems, renewable energy sources (e.g., solar, wind), and energy storage technologies (e.g., batteries).

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot electrical issues.

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and documentation skills.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

  • Commitment to safety and adherence to safety protocols.

  • Experience with electrical schematic generation and controller programming preferred.

  • Residing in Charlotte, NC area or willing to relocate within driving distance to lab.

  • Ability to lift and move laboratory equipment and materials (up to 50 pounds).

  • Comfortable working in a laboratory environment with potential exposure to electrical hazards.

Benefits

• Competitive salary
• Excellent Medical, dental, and vision insurance
• Flexible work hours with the requirement of being locally based in Charlotte, NC
• Highly dynamic and collaborative team environment
• Opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology and make a meaningful impact

Location

This role is based in Charlotte, NC. DEP embraces flexible working arrangements, offering a mix of office-based and remote work.

ABOUT YOU

Are you a detail-oriented, process-driven go getter who is committed to ending extreme poverty? If so, and the below bullets describe you, then you might be a great fit for The Adventure Project’s Operations Associate position.

  • You are an exceptional planner, organizer, and communicator.

  • You love process and are focused, detail-oriented, and accountable.

  • You enjoy working with data and are comfortable analyzing it

  • You’re ready to roll up your sleeves and hustle because you want to help create a better world.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Operations Associate is responsible for providing operational and administrative support, enabling each team member to do his or her best, most productive work. This position presents the exciting opportunity to work closely with the executive team and get exposure to various parts of a growing nonprofit (marketing, development, etc).

The Operations Associate will be responsible for the following:

Operational and Administrative Support (60%)

  • Lead supporter service and support by managing The Adventure Project supporter touch points across office phone, email, chatbot, web inquiries, and social media

  • Coordinate team travel internationally and domestically

  • Plan, coordinate, and provide key support for 1-3 events per year, in partnership with the executive team and board of directors

  • Project-based work, as needed (e.g. create a system for re-organizing files in the cloud)

  • Provide administrative support for grants management by working with partners to hit key deadlines and wiring funds to the field

  • Lead project management, utilizing Monday.com to ensure the team has understanding of ownership and upcoming deadlines and deliverables.

  • Schedule meetings, manage team calendars, and actively manage inboxes for our leadership team, notably CEO and Co-Founder, Becky Straw

Development Operations (20%)

  • Ensure the accuracy and maintenance of our CRM database so the development team can thank and engage donors appropriately, including weekly reconciliation process

  • Help manage and execute direct mail strategy throughout the year, but notably during holiday giving season

  • Lead inventory management, customer service, and logistics for our Online Holiday Shop

Marketing Operations (20%)

  • Schedule pre-written and pre-approved social media content in SproutSocial, in close partnership with the marketing team.

  • Manage social media calendar and library, ensuring assets are available and posts go out as planned

  • Engage our audience on social media by responding to comments / posts, inviting new followers, etc.

BASIC EXPECTATIONS

  • The Operations Associate should expect to work 10-20 hours per week, although opportunities to take on additional scope may be presented

  • Planned wages for this position are $25 / hour, but could vary based on experience

  • Position is fully remote, with travel unlikely.

QUALIFICATIONS / WORK EXPERIENCE

  • 3+ years of experience in operations or administrative support roles

  • Demonstrated track record managing administrative operations and events

  • Experience examining, developing, re-engineering, and implementing processes and procedures

  • Strong oral and written communications, with the ability to share information clearly and succinctly both in conversation and in writing

  • Excellent analytical skills

  • Comfortable using basic database and productivity tools including Google Suite, Office 365, Salesforce, and Monday.com (or similar project management software)

  • Passion, idealism, integrity, positive attitude, mission-driven, and self-directed

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

  • The chance to have a huge impact: our results show that job creation is one of the most sustainable and cost-effective ways to end extreme poverty. This role presents the unique opportunity to generate substantial impact as you help improve internal processes.

  • Mentorship and career development: we’ve worked hard to create an environment where team members are invested in each other’s success; that means we take the time to share (and ask for!) feedback, offer coaching / perspective, and help you grow as a social impact leader.

  • A great learning environment: this is a great opportunity for people interested in nonprofit management; you’ll get to explore all the ins and outs of running a nonprofit organization.

title: Frontend Developer
description:
Overview:

At TagLeaf, we're in pursuit of creating world-class products and experiences for our end users through the design and implementation of high quality, intuitive, and robust user interfaces.

We're seeking an experienced frontend engineer to join our team. You should have proven experience and deep knowledge in our front-end technology (VueJS, or alternatives in React / Angular), building complex UIs as part of a large enterprise application, and working as part of a remote engineering team. 

You should understand and see the growth potential in this industry and be excited to contribute to systems that will directly impact the people and processes that are driving that growth.

Who are we?

TagLeaf is an early-stage startup company, focused on bringing simplicity and transparency to the data we process - our first, wildly growing, market is Cannabis.

Our vision is to be the world’s software platform of choice for laboratories. We are used and loved by laboratories throughout the US and are quickly out-growing even our most optimistic projections. Within a few short years, we’ve already disrupted this space, and we are looking for talented, passionate, people to be a part of helping us take TagLeaf to the next level and achieve that vision.

We at TagLeaf love trying out new ideas, breaking things, seeing what works, and exploring cutting-edge technologies. We are absolutely passionate about changing the way consumers engage with products and helping scientists with the most intuitive, efficient software to help communicate valuable information to consumers.

You will be part of a small but passionate team building the systems and features that will drive our continued innovation of this rapidly growing industry and of laboratory sciences for other industries in the future.

Who are you?

  • Quality first: You value quality code! If you find yourself writing things twice you automatically refactor them. You find code reviews valuable instead of annoying.

  • Independent: Since we are 100% remote this means that you need to be able to reach your goals independently. You need to be self-aware and self-motivated.

  • Problem-solving attitude: Problems are opportunities! You see problems as challenging and have the urge to solve them. There is no problem in the world you cannot solve!

  • Self-improvement: You want to grow your skills and grow as a person. You seek ways to do things better, faster, and more efficiently.

  • Passion: Coding is your passion, not just a job. You just love to write good code.

  • Communication is Key: Ask questions, bring forth ideas, and don't be afraid to make your opinion heard. We're a small, nimble team and we're looking for someone who is excited to make a difference!


Key Responsibilities:

  • Development: Lead the development of high-quality, scalable, and maintainable code using Vue.js for the frontend and ensuring seamless integration with the Laravel-based backend. Implement robust features, functionalities, and custom components tailored to user needs.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with backend developers, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to ensure that the frontend development aligns with the overall product strategy and meets user needs.

  • Documentation: Create detailed, clear, and thorough documentation on the frontend design patterns, tools, and coding standards for future reference.

  • Mentorship: Guide and train the team on best practices in frontend development and optimization

  • Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on the latest industry trends, tools, and best practices in frontend development to keep our processes cutting-edge and efficient.

title: Product Designer
description:
What is Superform?

Superform is the universal yield marketplace. We are building the easiest way to access and distribute yield (ways to earn interest on your digital assets) across blockchains while remaining decentralized, permissionless, and non-custodial.

Superform was created with the belief that we can do better than the incumbent systems and corporations that govern our financial lives. We are building real tools that help real people solve real problems. From the protocol layer, to the execution layer, to the app layer, Superform Labs is building cutting edge solutions for the most pressing issues in decentralized finance. Whether you are a seasoned crypto veteran or a total web3 newbie - Superform Labs wants to work with anyone who is excited at the chance to majorly disrupt global finance for the better.

Superform Labs is backed by Polychain Capital, Circle Ventures, and more.

To learn more check out our content library.

The Role

Superform Labs is looking for an experienced designer to lead all product design related efforts for Superform. You’ll report directly to our head of product and co-founder as the sole product designer on the team. Your day to day will consist of research, design, and collaboration with the broader team. You will design the best way to earn and distribute yield on chain, emphasizing clarity, transparency, and beauty.

What you’ll do

  • Lead design of the Superform App user experience - crafting new user experiences and continually improving existing ones

  • Maintain and develop the Superform design system

  • Collaborate daily with product and engineering

  • Be boots on the ground, collecting user feedback and using that to inform and improve the app

  • Occasionally collaborate with our contract visual designers to develop branding & marketing content

Who you are:

  • Exceptional attention to detail, capable of delivering pixel-perfect designs when necessary

  • Deep understanding of design principles, relating to typography, color, and layout - with the flexibility to adhere to or deviate from them based on the project needs

  • Comprehensive understanding of the design process, from research to delivery - adaptable to both rapid turnarounds and long-term projects

  • Handing off your designs to engineers always goes smoothly because you provide fleshed out prototypes and clear requirements

  • You have a strong why behind every decision, ensuring that designs are not only visually appealing but also functionally effective

  • Passionate about staying informed of the landscape of comparable products, regularly exploring other crypto apps to bring innovative ideas and best practices into Superform’s design strategy

  • Possess the versatility to handle branding & marketing design tasks on occasion

  • Capable of understanding technical products at a deep level

  • Take pride in high-quality craftsmanship

  • You have great taste

Table Stakes

  • Strong project management skills, able to prioritize, time manage, self-organize, and work autonomously with minimal supervision. Capable of taking initiative to solve problems originating from engineers or users without needing repeated instructions or reminders

  • Eager to work in a driven, small team environment and participate in strengthening its culture, ready to embrace challenges, innovate, and have fun in a fast-paced setting

Requirements:

  • Minimum 3 years of design experience

  • Strong fluency in Figma

  • Experience building and maintaining design systems

  • Ability to overlap at least 4 hours with US east coast time zone

Nice to have:

  • Have worked in crypto/web3 or fintech

  • Some sort of formal design education

  • Some coding experience

  • Technical/content writing skills

  • Experience with prototyping tools like Origami, Framer, and Principle

  • Solid understanding of user research

Benefits

  • Work remotely anywhere in the world. Superform Labs is based on the east coast of the US and has small offices in New York and Miami. As a team we currently have teammates across North America, Europe, and Asia.

  • Generous equity included as part of compensation package

  • For US based employees

    • 401k with partial match

    • Insurance (health, dental, vision) FSA or HSA

*note - salary range may be adjusted based on candidate location

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Job Description: Outbound Sales Development Representative (SDR)

Company: Opensend
Location: North America, Remote
Department: Sales
Reports To: Director of Sales, Karen Katsumata 

About Opensend:

At Opensend, we turn data into customers through automated identity marketing. Our cutting-edge SaaS platform empowers website owners with actionable visitor identity insights, unlocking valuable first-party data—even from visitors who don’t make purchases or submit forms. With our unique and fully compliant technology, clients can scale their online and offline advertising, enhance multi-channel retargeting, and maximize the lifetime value of every customer. We transform unknown traffic into real business growth.

Role Overview:

Opensend is seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Outbound Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our expanding team. In this role, you will be instrumental in identifying and engaging with potential customers through outbound efforts, generating leads, and nurturing relationships to ultimately drive sales revenue.

Key Responsibilities:

Prospecting and Lead Generation:

  • Conduct research to identify and target outbound leads and accounts.

  • Utilize various tools and techniques to source and qualify new leads.

  • Create and maintain a robust pipeline of proactively sourced leads.

Outreach and Engagement:

  • Initiate contact with prospects through phone calls, emails, and social media outreach.

  • Craft compelling and personalized outreach messages to capture prospects' attention.

  • Schedule and coordinate appointments and product demonstrations for the sales team.

Qualification:

  • Conduct thorough qualification of outbound leads to assess their fit for Opensend’s products and services.

  • Identify key decision-makers within target organizations for effective engagement.

  • Collaborate with the sales team to ensure a smooth transition of qualified leads.

Sales Collateral and Communication:

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Opensend’s products and services to effectively communicate benefits and value propositions to prospects.

  • Share relevant marketing materials and resources with prospective leads to aid in their decision-making process.

Lead Nurturing:

  • Develop and nurture relationships with potential leads through ongoing communication and follow-ups.

  • Monitor and track prospect interactions, ensuring timely follow-up and engagement.

  • Implement lead nurturing strategies to move leads through the sales funnel effectively.

Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience in sales or business development or relevant marketing roles, preferably in e-commerce or SaaS industries

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities

  • Results-driven with a goal-oriented mindset

  • Proficient with CRM platforms such as HubSpot and familiar with tools like Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, and Apollo

  • Comfortable creating and sending personalized Loom videos to cold prospects

  • Ability to thrive both independently and within a collaborative team environment

  • Outgoing personality with a willingness to represent the company at conferences and networking events

  • (Bonus) An existing portfolio of clients or network they can bring with them

Does This Sound Like You? If So, You’ll Thrive at Opensend:

  • Ownership: You take full responsibility for challenges and decisions, always striving for lasting impact.

  • Infectious Enthusiasm: Your energy and passion drive action and inspire those around you.

  • Excellence: You push beyond expectations, delivering exceptional results with discipline and expertise.

  • Growth: You embrace challenges and continuously seek feedback to evolve.

  • Collaboration: You thrive in a team environment, fostering trust, empathy, and open communication.

  • Integrity: You do what’s right, earning trust through honesty and transparency.

  • Innovation: You turn obstacles into opportunities, thinking creatively to drive progress.

Application Process:

If you’re excited about the opportunity and believe you can contribute to our team, even if you don’t meet all qualifications, we encourage you to apply!

At Opensend, we value positive attitudes and a willingness to learn and grow.

Interested candidates should submit their resume outlining their qualifications and interest in the role.

title: Air Cargo Sales Representative
description:
Air Cargo Sales Representative

About Pelicargo

Are you interested in building the future of air cargo?

Pelicargo is a logistics-tech company that revolutionizes air cargo with a marketplace that allows freight forwarders to instantly book available cargo capacity with airlines. Developed at MIT, our technology makes air cargo fast, easy, and affordable by automatically matching cargo with the best possible flight option. We remove the stress of air cargo bookings for freight forwarders, streamlining operations so they can focus on growing their business, while providing airlines a real-time digital sales channel and data-driven market visibility. Pelicargo is venture-backed and growing fast!

 

Job Description

As Pelicargo’s Sales Representative, you will be responsible for the expansion of our air cargo business in the U.S. Your role is key in identifying and forging new paths for our company's growth, especially through outbound sales to untapped customers. Your focus will be on winning customers, building solid relationships with freight forwarders, and serving as the pivotal liaison between our customers and technology team to lay the groundwork for our global expansion.

 

Responsibilities

·          Drive our Air Cargo product expansion with proactive and energetic sales efforts, emphasizing continuous engagement in outbound sales to acquire new customers.

·          Specifically target and pitch to freight forwarders, leveraging your rich experience and extensive network, preferably with contacts within the U.S. freight forwarding community (Having industry experience with airline or GSA is preferred).

·          Cultivate strong relationships with freight forwarders and other key industry players, maximizing business opportunities.

·          Travel to meet customers, demonstrate our technology, and close business deals, showcasing your ability to expand our business ambitiously.

·          Collaborate with our sales & commercial team to define our sales strategy, explore new product offerings, and measure our results against industry benchmarks.

·          Ensure our offerings remain competitive and work with our product team to evolve our platform to meet the changing needs of our customers.

 

Applicants

Ideal candidates will have:

·          A minimum of 2-3 years of sales experience to freight forwarders, ideally at an airline or GSA, showing a proven track record of actively pursuing and securing new business through outbound sales.

·          With a strong preference for candidates possessing a significant network of contacts within the U.S. freight forwarder community.

·          An analytical mindset with a passion/interest for modern technology platforms and systems.

·          A high level of energy; willingness to go the extra mile to get things done.

·          An obsession with customer success: you understand that you succeed when they succeed.

·          Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.

·          Fluency in English (proficiency in other languages is a plus but not required).

Remuneration 

A base salary ranging from $60k to $85k per annum, commensurate with qualifications, augmented by an incentive bonus equivalent to approximately 10% of sales contributions. Detailed terms shall be subject to negotiation upon commencement of employment.

Working at Pelicargo

This is a fully remote position, providing full flexibility in your work day, along with the opportunity to be a part of a fast-growing company that is at the forefront of revolutionizing the air cargo industry.

title: AI/ML Lead
description:
Company Overview

Prophet Security is a force multiplier for security teams. Prophet AI for Security Operations leverages generative AI technology to streamline the triage, investigation, incident response, and remediation of alerts. As a result, Prophet reduces manual, tedious, repetitive work for security teams and empowers them to focus their time on higher value security tasks. We are seeking a talented software engineer to lead our efforts in developing artificial intelligence and machine learning capabilities that drive our product.

Role Summary

As our AI/ML Lead, you'll lead the integration and optimization of large language models (LLMs) and other AI/ML technologies into our product. Your expertise in LLM fine-tuning, evaluation, and productionization will directly enhance our product capabilities and user experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • LLM Integration & Feature Development: Lead the design and development of innovative features using LLMs, pushing the boundaries of Prophet's capabilities.

  • Prompt Engineering & Optimization: Master the art of prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and in-context learning to maximize the potential of LLMs within our product.

  • Model Evaluation & Benchmarking: Develop a rigorous model evaluation framework, extending benchmarks like MT-Bench to ensure the robustness and performance of our LLM implementations.

  • Safety & Guardrails: Establish comprehensive guardrails for safe and responsible use of LLMs, proactively mitigating potential risks.

  • Architectural Design: Shape the architecture of our LLM solutions, making strategic decisions on model configurability, portability, and cost (e.g., one large model vs. multiple task-specific models).

  • Research & Development: Stay at the forefront of LLM research, identifying groundbreaking techniques and tools to enhance our product offerings.

  • Mentorship: Guide and mentor junior Machine Learning Engineers, sharing your expertise and fostering a culture of innovation.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: Proven track record of successfully shipping LLM-powered products or features.

  • Technical Expertise: Deep understanding of LLMs, fine-tuning techniques, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and safety considerations. Proficient in Python.

  • Research Mind: Passionate about LLM research, with a demonstrated ability to translate cutting-edge, research concepts into practical applications.

  • Architectural Thinking: Experience designing and scaling ML systems, with a keen eye for optimizing performance and resource utilization.

  • In-depth Prompting Techniques: Familiarity with Chain-of-Thought (CoT), Tree of Thoughts (ToT), ReAct, and other advanced prompting strategies.

  • Knowledge Synthesis: Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) or similar techniques.

  • Problem-Solving: Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills, able to tackle complex challenges in the LLM domain.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication skills to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders and translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience building custom frameworks to streamline LLM interactions (similar to LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Guidance).

  • Familiarity with agentic architecture concepts and the role of LLMs in enabling agent-based systems.

  • Publications or Open-Source Contributions related to LLMs.

  • Experience with Go.

title: Senior Frontend UI Software Engineer – AI-based Security - Founding Team - Bay Area, CA
description:
Prophet Security is a VC-backed start-up building technology that leverage generative AI technology to streamline the triage and investigation of security alerts in enterprises.  We are looking for a talented Frontend Software Engineer to join as a core member of our founding engineering team, where your contributions will significantly shape our architecture and key technical decisions.

You will help drive our efforts in developing exceptional user experience and user interface components of our product using modern frontend technologies. You'll be shaping the look, feel, and functionality of our user interface. You'll bring your substantial React and TypeScript experience to drive the creation of intuitive, responsive, and visually stunning customer experiences.

Why Join?

At Prophet Security, we're not just building a platform that automates complex security tasks – we're building a company where engineers have a direct impact on customer success. As a member of our team, you'll have the unique opportunity to work closely with our initial customers, understand their needs, and see firsthand how your work is making a difference. You'll gain invaluable product sense and contribute directly to achieving product-market fit – a crucial experience for anyone looking to thrive in the early-stage startup world.  If you're passionate about building impactful products, working in a collaborative environment, and gaining valuable experience in a fast-growing startup, we encourage you to apply!

Key Responsibilities

  • Craft exceptional user experiences: Design and implement engaging web interfaces utilizing your React and Tailwind CSS expertise.

  • Build robust and maintainable components: Develop reusable and well-structured React components to ensure codebase scalability.

  • Drive frontend architecture: Contribute significantly to frontend architectural choices, establishing standards and promoting best practices.

  • Optimize for performance: Analyze and improve frontend performance, ensuring a seamless user experience.

  • Collaborate effectively: Work closely with designers, product managers, backend engineers, and early customers to deliver a top-notch UI.

Required Qualifications:

  • React mastery: Minimum of 5 years of hands-on development experience building web applications with React (including concepts like Hooks, state management, and performance optimization).

  • TypeScript fluency: In addition to JavaScript fundamentals, you have a solid understanding of TypeScript concepts, including types, interfaces, and generics.

  • Tailwind CSS expertise: Experience styling components with Tailwind CSS, demonstrating an understanding of its utility-first approach.

  • Design sensibility: A keen eye for design and the ability to translate design concepts from Figma into pixel-perfect interfaces.

  • Testing: Understanding of testing principles and experience with testing frameworks such as Jest or React Testing Library.

  • Version control: Proficiency with Git.

About Prophet Security

Prophet Security is a force multiplier for security teams. Our platform synthesizes alerts, develops and executes investigation plans, and provides detailed findings and recommendations. Analysts review the investigation, give feedback, and receive actionable remediation recommendations. Our system ensures that sensitive data is not used to train LLMs, preventing data leakage concerns. Our mission is to fundamentally shift cybersecurity power dynamics to favor defenders. 

Prophet Security’s founding team has over 30 years of experience in cybersecurity at leading companies including Abnormal Security, Expel, Madiant, McAfee, Oracle, Red Canary, Red Hat, Riverbed, and Symantec and are now focused on the Large market opportunity with the potential to disrupt the $400B security labor market.

We received Seed funding from Bain Capital Ventures, a leading tech-focused VC as well as several prominent security leaders and angel investors.  We are working with multiple design partners across high-tech, financial services, and healthcare sectors.  

Our employees are recognized as our top asset and we provide great benefits, meaningful equity participation, as well as a fun and inspiring environment to create and collaborate.

Our Culture

  • Customer Centricity: Focus on exceeding customer expectations and placing them at the core of decisions

  • Practicality over Perfection: Emphasis on efficient solutions and agile decision-making

  • Strive for Excellence: Commitment to high standards and continuous improvement

  • Transparent Communication: Encouragement of open, honest dialogue and collaborative trust

  • Unwavering Resilience: Determination to overcome challenges and persist in achieving goals

  • Have Fun: Foster a positive work environment that balances hard work with enjoyment and creativity

Environment

Prophet Security takes pride in being an equal-opportunity employer. We value a diverse and global talent pool and the collaboration that results from having a diverse and inclusive team.  All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.  Our hiring decisions are based exclusively on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

title: Campaign Manager -  Government Accounts
description:
Who you are


We’re looking for a Campaign Manager to lead strategy, execution, and client relationships for our government and public sector accounts. In this role, you’ll manage high-impact growth marketing campaigns while ensuring the specific needs of regulated environments are met with clarity, compliance, and creativity.

You’ll collaborate across internal teams and external partners to bring campaigns to life—on time, on budget, and with measurable impact. You’ll also help coordinate technical initiatives that support client objectives, from digital tool integration to platform rollouts.


What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the day-to-day lead for government client accounts, managing communications, expectations, and campaign performance

  • Develop and implement growth marketing strategies across paid media, email, social, search etc.

  • Write comprehensive briefs and campaign plans aligned with client goals and KPIs

  • Analyze performance data to inform strategy and continuously improve results

  • Coordinate with internal teams—creative, tech, and strategy—to ensure campaign alignment

  • Support the rollout of client-facing technologies, tools, or platforms

  • Ensure all work is delivered within scope, timeline, and budget

  • Contribute to client satisfaction, retention, and account growth

  • 3+ years of marketing experience in an agency, tech company, or high-growth environment

  • Must have experience or background in the public sector or regulated industries

  • Must have demonstrated success managing client-facing marketing projects

  • Strong knowledge of digital marketing tactics and performance metrics

  • Excellent communication skills—both written and verbal

Marketing insight

Familiarity with project/agency management tools such as Productive, JIRA, ASANA etc.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
👋 Join us at Remark

Join the Remark Revolution

Remark is reshaping the e-commerce landscape by harnessing the power of AI and personalized support to solve a critical problem: the low conversion rates plaguing online shopping. Our platform connects shoppers with trained product experts, using AI to enhance every interaction and turn browsing into buying. With Remark, we're not just selling products; we're providing a seamless, personalized shopping experience that boosts revenue and builds loyalty.

We're a mix of visionaries, tech enthusiasts, and, frankly, a few eccentrics who've sharpened our skills at giants like Amazon, Microsoft, and Salesforce. Now, we're channeling our collective expertise into building an environment that values curiosity, innovation, and a bit of fun along the way.

⚡️What we're looking for

As a Machine Learning Engineer working on Remark’s core platform, you will be responsible for planning, implementing, and testing features that change the way consumers buy online! Do you love solving complex AI problems, developing strategy and roadmaps, and working in a highly collaborative environment? If so, this could be the perfect match.

We build on a modern stack centered around TypeScript. Major elements include NestJS, Prisma, Bull, LangChain, and GraphQL. Ownership is a big facet of the culture at Remark, and as such we encourage strong input from each team member. If you feel strongly about building with something else, we'll hear you out.

📓Responsibilities

  • Develop and enhance our LLM-based operations and pipelines.

  • Work on cutting-edge role-playing and persona duplication techniques.

  • Report directly to our Chief Technology Officer.

  • Develop actionable roadmaps for new capabilities, and work with the engineering team execute on that roadmap.

  • Implement comprehensive evals for new capabilities.

  • Balance speed and quality, with a focus on tangible results.

  • Participate in frequent code-reviews with fellow team members.

🛠Qualifications

  • Strong background in Deep Learning, Machine Learning, and NLP.

  • Proficient in JavaScript and Python.

  • Expertise in building applications leveraging LLMs, with an understanding of performance, latency, and deployment considerations.

  • Familiarity with LLM-enabled tooling, including frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), vector databases, caching solutions (Redis), and monitoring tools.

  • Knowledge of secure deployment practices and robustness against prompt injection.

  • Passion for solving customer problems, developing strategies and roadmaps, and executing those plans to bring value to our business and customers.

  • Experience with using qualitative and quantitative data (especially from A/B tests) to make engineering decisions. You also know when and how to balance data with intuition.

🎈Bonus points if

  • You thrive when things move fast

  • You have a cute pup 🐶

  • You appreciate roasted veggies

  • You avoid single use plastic

  • You've seen a mountain goat 🐐

⚕️Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Full healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision)

  • Flexible PTO (at least 15 days / year recommended)

  • At least 1 company retreat to Colorado annually

  • $500 expense reimbursement for qualified fitness and outdoor recreation activities

🚀 Ready to join?

Let's do this! The jobs listed are guidelines — not perfect outlines — of who we expect you to be. We'd love to hear from you even if you color outside the lines.

At Remark, we're building a workplace where everyone can belong. We're committed to diversity and inclusion and encourage applicants from all backgrounds to join our team. Remark is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Levellr is hiring a fully remote full stack engineer to to join our fast-growing startup. You’ll join a team working to craft an incredible product to some of the world’s largest gaming companies, brands and music labels to help them launch, grow, manage and monetize communities on Discord. Who are you?

  • You have a proven ability to learn fast, ship fast, and get stuff done as part of a small team

  • You have 5+ years of professional software development experience, including both frontend and backend work

  • You want to work as part of a fully-remote development team, and you’re happy to work in a European timezone

  • You have strong knowledge of TypeScript and/or JavaScript

  • You ship beautiful web apps with frontend frameworks like Svelte, React or Vue

  • You’re not afraid of SQL and getting your hands dirty with relational databases like PostgreSQL

  • You know your way around GitHub and you’re comfortable with Git

  • Ideally you have previous startup/growth-stage experience and previous remote-work experience, or you’re excited to acquire that

  • You are self-motivated and proactive with an independent working style

  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Who we are

Levellr is run by two co-founders, Tom (CEO) and Ben (CTO), who have been building communities for the last 15 years at companies big (YouTube, Interpublic Group) and small (MyCujoo). We’ve been working on the business since early 2021 and are backed by Crush Ventures and a portfolio of strategic and valuable angels.

  • We work flexibly. We work around school runs, workouts at the gym, meals with the kids, and the occasional random day off for day trips or long weekends.

  • We thrive in uncertainty. We listen to market feedback and iterate continuously to build products our customers love.

  • We avoid hierarchy. We do the right thing without needing anyone to chase us or watch over our shoulders.

  • We aim for balance. We work to build a business that will give our teams (and their families!) balanced and happy lives for many years to come.

Benefits

  • 5 weeks holiday allowance (plus public holidays)

  • Access to Spill, our mental health platform

  • Hybrid remote & flexible working hours

  • Yearly company offsites (next one is in August!)

  • Stock options

  • Home office budget once you pass 3 months probation

  • Work Laptop

title: Housekeeper – Colorado Springs
description:
Job Overview

Renjoy manages 200+ vacation rental properties across Colorado Springs and Woodland Park — and we're scaling fast. We're not a cleaning company. We're a hospitality company, inspired by Will Guidara's Unreasonable Hospitality. Your work is the last thing that happens before a guest walks through the door, and it's the single biggest driver of our reviews. We treat this role accordingly.

✅ No resume required. Show up consistently, work hard, and communicate well. That's what matters.

Pay & Schedule

💰 $18–19/hour, based on experience and reliability

🕒 Cleaning shifts are between 9:30 AM and 4:30 PM, 7 days a week

⏱️ Each shift is typically 5–6 hours

📌 Sunday availability is mandatory — it's when everyone checks out from their weekend trip!

If you're looking for part-time work, Saturdays, Sundays, and Mondays are where we need the most help.

What You'll Do

Walk into vacation homes after guests check out — sometimes tidy, sometimes not — and reset them completely before the next guests arrive. You'll follow detailed checklists, deep clean kitchens and bathrooms, change all linens, make beds, restock supplies, and flag anything that needs maintenance through our app. Every home has to be guest-ready by 4:00 PM.

Some stays get a small personal touch — a coloring book left out for a family with kids, a trail guide for an active couple. We supply the items and flag the opportunity. You execute it. It takes two minutes and it's the kind of thing guests remember.

What We're Looking For

You work hard and move with purpose. You don't need someone standing over your shoulder — you own your checklist and your standard. When something looks off, you report it. When a home is trashed, you reset it with the same energy as an easy turn.

You also:

  • Are physically up for the work — stairs, lifting, on your feet all shift

  • Have your own reliable vehicle — properties span Colorado Springs and Woodland Park

  • Are comfortable using a smartphone app for tasks and communication

  • Can commit to a consistent weekly schedule, Sundays required

  • Take pride in a clean that actually looks and feels clean

Why Renjoy

Most cleaning jobs treat you like you're replaceable. We don't. You're a hospitality professional — the person who determines whether a guest's trip starts right. We invest in that: clear checklists, quality supplies, managers who respond, and a team that actually communicates.

We also invest in your growth. Our best housekeepers move into Team Lead and Assistant Housekeeping Manager roles as we scale. If you do great work, you'll get more hours, more recognition, and a real career path — not just a paycheck.

If you see something broken, say it. If you have a better way to do something, tell us. We want people who care.

description:

title: Research Associate  - Peptide Chemistry
description:
Amide Technologies is a Massachusetts-based biotech company focused on synthesizing peptides that are difficult to obtain through existing means, bridging the gap between traditional solid phase peptide synthesis and biological expression. By using unnatural amino acids and artificial protein backbones, our team is expanding possibilities in peptide drug design.

Research Associate

Amide is seeking an exceptional individual to join our growing team as a Research Associate/Technician. The successful candidate will be a key contributor to various research projects and be responsible for executing laboratory experiments, analyzing and reporting results, and working within a larger team on a regular basis. Applicants should be team players able to excel in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Responsibilities

  • Use proprietary flow chemistry synthesis technology to synthesize next-gen peptides and proteins

  • Use LCMS, Flash, HPLC and FPLC instrumentation to purify/analyze peptides and proteins

  • Troubleshoot challenging technical, experimental, and instrumental issues

  • Meticulously record and analyze data

  • Prepare and maintain laboratory reagents and instruments

  • Regularly discuss progress of work

Requirements

  • BS or MS degree or equivalent experience in chemistry, chemical engineering, biochemistry or related field

  • May have experience in organic synthesis including solid-phase peptide synthesis

  • May have experience in LC-MS, mass spectrometry, HPLC, FPLC, UV-VIS, NMR, FT-IR or related techniques

  • May have experience in purification

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Enthusiasm, independence, and a willingness to learn in a fast-paced, team environment

The position is full time and the Research Associate will be based at the company’s headquarters in Waltham, Massachusetts, USA.  Flexibility with regard to working hours is required.  The Research Associate will report to the Senior Scientist - Peptide Chemistry.

Amide Technologies offers a challenging and exciting role in one of the Northeast’s most innovative biotech companies. The company offers a competitive compensation package including salary, bonus and equity.

  • Experience with buying and selling cryptocurrency
