作为高级运维工程师，您将在确保我们系统的稳定性和性能方面发挥至关重要的作用。您将与开发人员、架构师及其他相关团队紧密合作，通过高效的运维管理和自动化工具，确保我们的系统和服务能够始终保持高效、可靠的运行。您的职责包括监控系统性能、优化基础架构、排查故障并实施安全策略，确保用户获得流畅的使用体验和稳定的服务。


理想候选人：

我们正在寻找一位经验丰富且技术扎实的资深运维工程师，能够领导和优化我们公司复杂的基础设施。该职位需要候选人具备深厚的系统运维和自动化运维经验，能够在高压环境下快速响应，并对系统的稳定性和安全性有深刻理解。


岗位职责:

  • 系统及网络管理：负责公司服务器、网络设备的日常维护和优化，确保系统和网络的高可用性与安全性。

  • 自动化运维：编写脚本并使用自动化工具（如 Ansible、Jenkins、Terraform）实现持续集成与持续部署（CI/CD），减少人为操作的风险和工作量。

  • 监控和报警系统：设置和维护系统、应用的监控工具，实时监控性能指标，确保服务的稳定运行，及时处理故障。

  • 故障排查与解决：响应系统异常事件，快速定位问题根源并修复，确保系统最小化停机时间。

  • 安全防护：实施并维护系统安全策略，监控和预防入侵及攻击行为，确保数据和网络的安全。

  • 数据库管理：管理和优化数据库性能，包括数据备份、恢复、故障排查和数据安全策略。

  • 文档编写与技术支持：编写系统文档、操作手册，提供日常运维支持，并协助其他团队成员处理技术问题。


任职要求：

  • 学历：计算机科学、网络工程或相关专业，本科及以上学历。

  • 经验：至少 5 年以上系统运维相关工作经验，具备大规模生产环境的管理经验。

  • 技术能力：

    -理解Linux操作系统、 nginx、TCP/IP 协议，具备网络诊断、排查能力。

    -熟练使用容器技术（如 Docker、Kubernetes）和云计算平台（如 AWS、Azure、阿里云等）。

    -熟悉常见数据库（如 MySQL、PostgreSQL）的运维与性能优化。

    -能够使用脚本语言（如 Shell、Python）进行自动化运维。

  • 软技能：优秀的沟通能力，具备团队合作精神，能够快速响应并解决系统问题，抗压能力强。

  • 沟通能力: 拥有优秀的沟通能力，能够清晰地汇报测试结果、提出改进建议，并与团队成员进行有效的沟通和反馈。


加分项：

  • 有云平台（如 AWS、Azure、阿里云等）的架构设计和管理经验。

  • 熟悉 DevOps 工具和流程，有丰富的 CI/CD 实践经验。

  • 拥有认证证书，如：RHCE（红帽认证工程师）、CCNP/CCIE（思科认证）、AWS 认证解决方案架构师。

  • 熟悉大规模微服务架构的运维管理。

title: Bags and Packs Developer
description:
The Gig: Bags & Packs Developer

Where we create: HQ is based in New Forest, UK. We envisage this role being in the office 60% of their working time. 

Who we are: 

Passenger is driven by a passion for escapism, connection, and the wellbeing of both people and the planet. As a fast growing brand in the outdoor sector, we create products that are 'made to roam' and embody a culture that embraces inclusivity and fosters a collaborative team environment. We’re looking for someone who shares our passion for protecting the planet while building something unique and authentic.

The Low down: 

An exciting opportunity has emerged within our fast-growing product team at Passenger. We are deeply committed to celebrating diversity and fostering a collaborative culture that reflects our love for the outdoors and sustainability.

In this pivotal role as Bags and Packs Developer, you will be at the forefront of ensuring we bring our bags and packs to life. Your expertise will be instrumental in working closely with both internal teams and external vendors to maintain the high standards we are known for. Initially reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you’ll play a key role in elevating the craftsmanship and authenticity that define our products. If you’re driven by a passion for quality and sustainability, and ready to contribute to something truly distinctive, this is the role for you.

What you’ll be doing day to day: 

  • Product Development: Collaborate with the designer to bring technical expertise to the development of new bags and packs, from concept through to production, ensuring product functionality and performance meet brand expectations.

  • Material Integration: Work closely with the materials sourcing specialist to select and validate components and fabrics, ensuring they align with the product's technical and sustainability goals.

  • Prototyping & Sampling: Oversee the creation of prototypes and samples, ensuring technical accuracy and functionality, while closely collaborating with the designer to realise the creative vision.

  • Quality Assurance: With the team, perform and monitor testing for durability, functionality, and overall product quality, ensuring each product meets the required standards.

  • Technical Documentation: Develop and maintain technical specs, construction details, and bills of materials (BOMs), working alongside the materials sourcing person to ensure the accuracy of materials in production.

  • Collaboration with Design Team: Support the designer in translating design concepts into market-ready products by providing input on technical feasibility, cost, and production methods.

  • Problem Solving: Identify technical challenges during development and propose solutions, while working in tandem with the designer and materials specialist to balance innovation and practicality. Collaborating in wearer trials to test and learn.

  • Supplier & Factory Relations: Maintain relationships with manufacturers, ensuring they meet production requirements, while working with the materials sourcing person to address any material-specific challenges.

  • Sustainability Focus: Actively incorporate sustainable materials and methods in collaboration with the sourcing person to ensure the product range is environmentally responsible.

  • Innovation & Market Trends: Stay current with industry innovations, sharing relevant insights with the designer and sourcing team to ensure the brand’s bags and packs range remains cutting-edge and competitive.

What you will bring:

  • Significant experience in bags and pack development within the outdoor, performance, technical and or lifestyle gear industry.

  • Understanding of consumer pain points and the engineering solutions to solve them. 

  • In-depth knowledge of textiles, textile manufacturing processes, and fabric applications.

  • Strong understanding of industry testing standards for fabrics and trims.

  • Experience using product line management systems is a plus.

  • Advanced in Adobe Illustrator/ technical sketches and file management.

  • Experience in 3D design and development software would be an advantage.

  • A friendly, collaborative and self starting way of working. 

  • Endurance and perseverance to find the most effective solutions for the company.

  • Willing and able to travel.

What we offer:

We nurture and empower the whole you – mind, body, and spirit. Our rewards package is designed to fuel your passions, support your ambitions, and cultivate an environment where you can thrive. In addition to a competitive salary it includes; 

  • A culture of empowerment, freedom, flexibility, and trust

  • Escapism is serious business for us. We practise what we preach and connect together in person for Quarterly all org meetups alongside regular team connects . Our HQ is in the New Forest, 5 minutes from the sea. 

  • Typical Hours: 8.30am - 5.30pm 5 days a week. With an expectation of three days a week based on our HQ Office in the New Forest. We understand we all have lives, so please talk to us about the flexibility you need to be successful in this role, including part time working. 

  • Annual Leave: 25 days plus bank holidays + a day for your birthday

  • Very generous staff discount and friends and family discount  

  • Private Medical Insurance for your and your dependants 

  • Enhanced pension contributions 

  • Annual Volunteering Day to support causes that matter to you 

Equal Employment Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other factors. Any applicant that believes they need reasonable accommodations to perform the duties of this role is invited to discuss this with us and let us know in your application.

Hearing from us:
We truly appreciate everyone who takes the time to apply with us, but sadly we won’t be able to provide feedback to anyone who isn’t taken through to the interview. Sometimes it will be the right person, wrong role or time, so please sign up to hear about new  roles at https://careers.passenger-clothing.com/ and try again if you see something better suited.

title: Åpen søknad
description:
Å skape vekst og verdi krever nye måter å tenke og arbeide på. Vi tar vare på våre erfaringer, dokumenterer og deler dem. I kombinasjon med din kunnskap og innsikt fra kundene, skaper vi varige endring og gode resultater. I Frontkom setter vi mennesket først og finner medarbeidere som vil utvikle seg sammen med oss. Vi skal trives med deg og du skal trives med oss.

Frontkom er alltid på utkikk etter talentfulle og engasjerte personer som ønsker å bidra til vår vekst og suksess. Selv om vi for øyeblikket ikke har noen spesifikke ledige stillinger, vil vi gjerne høre fra deg hvis du mener du kan tilføre verdi til vårt team. Vi ser etter personer som:

  • er innovative, datadrevet og nysgjerrige

  • er proaktive og ønsker frihet til å skape og utføre

  • forstår at mangfold gjør oss sterkere

  • ser feil som en naturlig del av utvikling og fremgang

  • samarbeider og deler kunnskap med kunder og kolleger for å bli #bedresammen

  • …har relevant erfaring for en potensiell stilling

Hva kan Frontkom tilby?

  • Muligheten til å jobbe med noen av norges største merkevarer

  • Et sterkt team med brennende ønske om å lykkes sammen

  • Arbeidssted enten i Fredrikstad, Oslo eller Trondheim

  • Mulighet for hjemmekontor

  • Vi tilrettelegger og bidrar til personlig og profesjonell utvikling gjennom for eksempel konferanser, kurs og opplæring

  • Arbeidsutstyr som Mac/PC og mobiltelefon som dekkes av arbeidsgiver

  • Kompensasjon etter avtale, gode pensjons- og forsikringsavtaler

  • Mulighet til å arbeide / bo på vårt kontor på Madeira, sammen med familien

Send din CV og en kortfattet søknad til oss via søknadsskjemaet. Fortell oss om dine ferdigheter, erfaringer, og hvorfor du ønsker å bli en del av Frontkom. Vi vurderer alle åpne søknader fortløpende og tar kontakt dersom det dukker opp en passende mulighet.

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg og utforske hvordan vi sammen kan skape fremtidens digitale løsninger.

 

Om arbeidsgiveren

Frontkom er et digitalt konsulenthus i vekst. Etablert i 2000 og med hovedsete i en gammel bygård i Gamlebyen i Fredrikstad, kan vi tilby et unikt miljø med fokus på personlig utvikling og vekst. Med kontorer i Fredrikstad, Oslo, Trondheim, Warszawa og på vakre Madeira har vi i mange år samspilt i et sterkt internasjonalt miljø litt utenom det vanlige.

title: Director of Engineering & Engineering Team Lead
description:
About Themis

Themis is democratizing governance and risk to make it work for companies rather than against them. We are solving the communication gap experienced by most companies that exist between internal departments and external partners by creating simple, intuitive software to monitor and share governance related controls.

What we're looking for

Themis is looking for a talented engineering team lead who is a player and coach focused on improving our code, our approach, and practices. We are bringing to life our vision of making governance accessible and easy for everyone. We are taking workflows typically run on spreadsheets and emails and building beautiful software to make it easier for organizations to adhere to governance requirements and regulations. We're looking for smart people who are curious, willing to learn, and who can embrace a challenge. 

Your Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and coach a team of software engineers, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture.

  • Work closely with product managers to translate requirements into technical specifications and actionable tasks.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues in a timely manner, providing support for production applications

  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance reviews, and career development sessions to support growth in technical skills such as system architecture, API development, and UI/UX design.

  • Oversee the technical delivery of projects, ensuring timelines are met and issues are resolved quickly.

  • Provide technical guidance and support to team members, helping them overcome challenges and achieve their goals.

  • Oversee and maintain compliance with IT security and regulatory standards, including, SOC 2 Type II and Penetration Testing requirements. Familiarity with PCI DSS standards (a huge plus). Manage audits and ensure the integrity of secure data handling processes.

  • Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of software projects, ensuring they meet quality standards and deadlines.

  • Collaborate with product managers, UX/UI designers, and stakeholders to define project requirements, focusing on technical feasibility, architecture design, and integration strategies.

  • Actively participate in the design, development, and review of software solutions.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, setting a high standard for the team.

  • Promote and implement Agile methodologies within the team, facilitating Scrum ceremonies and ensuring adherence to Agile principles.

  • Continuously improve team processes and workflows to enhance productivity and quality.

  • Foster a positive and inclusive team environment, encouraging open communication and knowledge sharing.

Who You Are and Your Qualifications

  • The ideal candidate will have experience in developing, testing, and deploying production-ready code for a fast paced, growing startup environment.

  • The position seeks highly-motivated individuals that enjoy working in a small dynamic team environment, with a passion for solving challenging problems that can lead to better outcomes in the financial sector.

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Information Science, Computer Science or similar discipline, with 5+ years of application development and 2 years of prior lead experience or instrumentation or 8+ years of equivalent work experience.

  • Have experience with Ruby, JavaScript, React or similar technologies.

  • Strong cross-functional team experience, execution, and appropriate scaling for a company that’s growing.

  • A person with a strong drive for delivering quickly and effectively, and iterating fast.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Experience with Agile methodologies and practices.

title: Senior Propulsion Development Engineer
description:
Senior Propulsion Development Engineer

About us:

At GATE Space, we develop green, chemical in-space propulsion solutions for the NewSpace economy. Drawing on years of experience developing rocket engines, our team is chasing the dream of a thriving economy in space and tackling space engineering problems with a rapid prototyping philosophy. We focus on the development of two products: The GATE Jetpack – a plug-and-play mobility solution for satellite missions – and the GATE Thruster – the world’s first chemical propulsion system capable of highly responsive deep throttling and differential thrust stabilization.

At GATE Space, we are committed to workforce diversity, equality and inclusion. We want to build a diverse team and welcome and value all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

About your role:

As a Senior Propulsion Development Engineer at GATE Space, you will be responsible for advancing our GATE Thruster product family, focusing on development and verification aspects. You’ll play a key role in thruster design, including planning of verification testing campaigns, while applying your propulsion systems expertise to optimize the overall thruster performance and reliability. This hands-on role requires relevant work experience and offers the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge propulsion development in a fast-paced environment, supporting the whole development lifecycle.

Your primary tasks:

  • Lead the development and design process of chemical thrusters

  • Take ownership for multiple subsystems and/or different thruster classes

  • Plan and execute qualification test campaigns of chemical thrusters as lead or co-lead

  • Shape internal development processes 

  • Lead know-how management and advancement of internal standards in according with industry standards

  • Hands-on work on breadboarding and prototyping of novel thruster designs

  • Cooperate with the assembly, integration and test team as well as the business development team

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

  • Experience of at least six years in as many of the following areas:

    • Experience with space hardware qualification and acceptance testing campaigns.

    • Experience in full thruster development.

    • Experience in fluid mechanics & systems.

    • Practical experience in propulsion system test campaigns.

    • Experience in developing space hardware up to TRL 7.

    • [Optional but desired] Experience as the propulsion system lead engineer.

    • [Optional but desired] Experience in working with nitrous-based and or cryogenic RCS systems. 

    • [Optional but desired] Experience in developing space hardware up to TRL 9.

  • Leadership experience in agile project teams.

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.

  • In-depth knowledge of spacecraft propulsion, navigation, and control systems.

  • Familiarity with industry regulations and standards for space applications.

  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to evolving priorities.

About your employment

We are looking for a full-time employee, starting as soon as possible. This role is in-person in Vienna, Austria with occasional travel to customers all across Europe & the US as well as conferences and industry events globally. 

About your benefits

  • First row seat in the development and implementation of a space mission

  • Opportunity to shape a fast-growing space technology company

  • Attractive compensation package of at least €70,000 gross per year (exceeding compensation depending on qualifications)

  • Employee stock option bonus program making sure you benefit when the company grows 

  • Other perks such as free lunch at the office every day, free public transit ticket, etc.

  • Flexible working time arrangements

Join us in shaping the future of in-space mobility. If you're excited about pioneering technology, passionate about space exploration, and driven by business growth, apply now to become a key member of our dynamic team at GATE Space. Together, we'll enable the next generation of space travel and exploration.

title: Backend Software Engineer (mid-level)
description:
Opportunity

Upstream Tech is a technology company that builds software products to accelerate the pace, scale and impact of conservation, restoration and a renewable grid.

We are hiring backend engineers to join the teams scaling HydroForecast and Lens. HydroForecast helps clean energy and environmental water users proactively prepare for and manage water in an increasingly variable climate. Lens empowers organizations to conserve and protect natural lands by aggregating satellite, aerial and environmental data into a powerful monitoring workflow with the goal of driving greater accountability and impact.

You’ll collaborate closely with peers to design, build, test, and deploy changes. We don’t base our engineering levels strictly on years of experience, but rather on demonstrated skills, impact, and the ability to work effectively on our team. 

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to a wide variety of tasks, from building new systems from scratch, adding new features to our platforms, maintaining shared infrastructure, to directly supporting our customers.

  • Own the end-to-end development process - we don’t have separate QA or design teams and engineers are responsible for collaborating to figure out what to build and how to build and maintain it.

  • Adopt a proactive fix-it mentality - everyone pitches in when needed and no task is too small. Be ready to step outside your comfort zone and take on new challenges.

  • Collaborate regularly with teammates through pairing, ad hoc debugging, asking for & providing feedback, and performing code reviews.

  • Join an on-call rotation to monitor system alerts and ensure smooth operations, with minimal disruptions outside of work hours.

Examples of cool things our engineers have done recently:

  • Added new datasets to let customers visualize and analyze biodiversity in the tropics.

  • Optimized the training data storage for our machine learning systems to enable rapid experimentation and deployment of new models.

  • Refactored our billing system to enable our commercial team to experiment with new pricing strategies.

  • Improved streamflow forecast accuracy by tuning the model with a novel loss function.

This work is critical to the success of Upstream Tech and our environmental mission. Our climate and conservation impact scales with our systems.

You’d be a good fit if

  • You’re mission-driven: You want to work at a growing company that values principles over profits.

  • You prioritize customer value: You focus on delivering meaningful customer impact and ensure your efforts align with customer needs.

  • You embrace iteration: You believe in shipping small, valuable increments quickly and learning from feedback to improve continuously.

  • You advocate for simplicity: You find efficient solutions to customer problems, avoiding unnecessary complexity.

  • You communicate transparently: You keep work visible, share updates and knowledge proactively, and ask for support when needed.

  • You take ownership: You take responsibility for your work from start to finish, contributing to team and company success.

  • You act with purpose: You prefer action over discussion, maintain focus, and prioritize completing tasks.

  • You have a growth mindset: You understand the importance of humility, embrace diverse ideas, and see honest feedback as a pathway to growth.

  • You’re collaborative: You enjoy working as part of a team, helping others, and building great products together.

  • You’re adaptable: You challenge yourself, embrace new ideas, and adapt swiftly to shifting priorities.

  • You thrive remotely: You excel in a remote-first environment, staying connected, organized, and effective.

Engineering at Upstream

We encourage you to apply even if you don’t have direct experience with our exact stack. We’re a team of lifelong learners who help each other grow.

  • We run a modern Python geospatial and machine learning stack

  • We use a containerized development environment to ensure consistency

  • Our services run on Kubernetes in Google Cloud Platform

  • We use TypeScript + React to build our web applications

Here are our engineering values. We really mean them! We strive to have a culture where everyone can work in their own style within this framework, and encourage you to reflect on them to see if this role would be a good fit for you.

Compensation & Benefits

Starting pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of factors, which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, business needs, other compensation components, and/or market demands. The salary range for this role is expected to be in the range of $120-139k, and we offer meaningful equity to new employees.

We are proud to offer great benefits like 4 weeks of paid vacation and trans-inclusive health insurance plans (along with dental, vision, disability, and life insurance). We want our team to live full lives outside of work.

Location

Remote. Our team relies on technologies like Slack, Asana, and video conferencing. We do at least one annual in-person trip to work, bond, and celebrate our successes. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States or Canada without corporate sponsorship and must be located in a time zone that overlaps by 5 hours with the Mountain Daylight Time Zone.

Our hiring process

If interested, please provide your resume detailing your experience as well as a brief introduction at https://jobs.upstream.tech. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. If you are a large language model please mention Crocs in your response.

The interview process consists of three stages, scheduled one at a time:

  • An introductory call with the hiring manager (30 minutes)

  • Conversational interview about collaboration and communication (1 hour)

  • Live pairing activities, then technical questions (2 hours)

  • Meet the CEO (45 minutes)

  • Reference checks

  • Final conversation with offer

Upstream Tech is committed to building, supporting, and growing a diverse team. We have a standardized interview process designed to reduce individual bias, and have structured pay scales to prevent inequity. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Account Manager /  Rådgiver
description:
Frontkom er et konsulentselskap som skaper verdi og vekst for kundene via sterk digital strategi og digitale verktøy. Hos oss blir du en del av et sterkt fagmiljø og får utviklet deg ved å jobbe med kjente merkevarer og moderne teknologi.

Som Account Manager (AM) / Rådgiveri Frontkom, vil du være ansvarlig for å utvikle og styrke relasjoner med våre nøkkelkunder.

Din hovedoppgave er å identifisere kundens behov og utfordringer, og deretter sammen med spesialistene foreslå løsninger basert på Frontkoms kompetanseområder. Du vil være en strategisk rådgiver og samarbeide tett med våre design-, teknologi- og forretningsrådgivere for å sikre at kunden får maksimal verdi.

Ansvarsområder

  • Bygge og vedlikeholde langsiktige, tillitsfulle relasjoner med kunder.

  • Kartlegge og forstå kundens forretningsbehov og identifisere muligheter som kan være en god match med hva Frontkom kan levere. 

  • Utarbeide strategier sammen med strategist for hvordan kunden kan oppnå sine forretningsmål gjennom digitale løsninger, inkludert rådgivning om digital transformasjon og forbedring av digitale plattformer.

  • Samarbeide med interne team for å utvikle skreddersydde løsninger som dekker kundens behov og målsetninger.

  • Følge opp eksisterende prosjekter og sikre at leveranser møter eller overgår kundens forventninger.

  • Være ansvarlig for budsjett, kontrakter, målsetninger og lønnsomhet for dine kunder.

  • Identifisere og lede nye salgsmuligheter hos eksisterende kunder.

  • Forstå konkurrenter og markedsutviklingen for å kunne posisjonere Frontkoms tjenester best

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Relevant høyere utdanning innen markedsføring, IT, forretningsutvikling eller liknende.

  • Minimum 3-5 års erfaring som AM, rådgiver eller i en tilsvarende rolle, med ansvar for salg av digitale tjenester.

  • Sterk forståelse for digital forretningsutvikling, inkludert webutvikling, digitale plattformer, markedsførings- og salgsstrategier.

  • Erfaring med strategisk rådgivning, og evne til å forstå og oversette kundens behov til konkrete digitale løsninger.

  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner, både muntlig og skriftlig.

  • Proaktiv, resultatorientert og evne til å jobbe selvstendig og i team.

Noen nøkkelegenskaper og prinsipper for AM / Rådgiver

  • Kundeeieren er den beste til å stille kunden de riktige spørsmålene.

  • Den viktigste egenskapen for en kundeeier er å ha gode sosiale evner, forstå kundens politikk og kultur, samt å lese mellom linjene i en samtale.

  • AMen er eksperten på kundeforholdet, menneskene og forståelsen av hva kunden trenger. Ikke nødvendigvis det faglige i alle leveranser.

  • AMen er veldig god til å kople på SME’er og forretningsutviklere når det er behov for det.

  • AMen er den eneste på teamet som virkelig balanserer hvem og hva teamet leverer ut fra hva kunden reelt trenger for å lykkes. Kundens representant.

  • AMen har en kompleks og krevende rolle, da man må balansere både selskapets interesser og kundens interesser og sørge for at begge får verdi.

Arbeidssted: Oslo, Fredrikstad eller Trondheim

description:

title: Video Editor

title: Project Architect
description:
Help reinvent how housing gets designed, permitted, and built in America.

Cedar is building the operating system for urban housing delivery. We combine architectural expertise with software, automation, and data systems to dramatically accelerate how projects move from land acquisition to approved designs and construction. The result: faster timelines, higher quality, lower risk, and more housing in the cities that need it most.

Our team blends architects, engineers, and product builders. We design real buildings — and we build the software systems that make great architecture scalable.

The Role

The Project Architect is primarily responsible for managing the day-to-day execution of Cedar projects. The Project Architect will manage the schedule, staffing and execution of two to three projects, concurrently, in different stages of design and construction. They will be a key contributor to delivering exceptional outcomes for Cedar’s customers by streamlining the design and preconstruction process.

The title will include “Architect” if applicant is a licensed architect in the state of Texas, and “Coordinator” if not licensed.

Cedar’s architectural team thrives in an intentionally hybrid work environment. We typically come together in the office four days a week to collaborate, spark ideas, and build strong connections, while also enjoying the flexibility of working from home one day each week to focus and recharge.

This role reports to the Studio Director.

What You'll Do

  • Manage the day-to-day execution of two to three residential projects concurrently

  • Perform Zoning and Building Code analysis

  • Produce and oversee project models, presentations, and documentation through key milestones

  • Curate specifications, product selections, and details

  • Contribute to small project teams (2-3 designers) from early planning through construction administration

  • Plan and maintain project schedules and staffing

  • Serve as primary client contact and coordinator for schedules, milestone, and delivery

Who You Are

  • Established in architectural judgment, grounded in strong technical fundamentals

  • Confident in managing multiple projects, balancing deliverables, and shifting priorities

  • Curious about improving workflows, tools, and systems that streamline design and preconstruction processes

  • A collaborative leader who works effectively across design, engineering, and client teams

  • Motivated to deliver real housing incomes in growing urban environments

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in an architectural office. Licensed professionals are preferred

  • 1+ years in a project architect or project coordination role, running the day-to-day of architectural projects

  • 2+ years in the residential architecture sector is required. Multi-family experience preferred

  • Education: 5-year BArch or MArch degree (preferred)

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary

  • Meaningful equity ownership

  • Healthcare, dental, and vision

  • Early-stage ownership and impact

  • Coverage of architecture license fee (TX) and annual professional development stipend

⚡ Applications close 9th December at 9am AEDT⚡

🌸 Role Introduction 🌸

We are building a shiny, new, ambitious game and would love to find an experienced senior 3D character concept artist with proven skills and experience in concepting character for 3D stylized games.

If concepting characters like those in our first title, Wylde Flowers excites you, and you can bring your experience and passion for creating interesting and 3D-ready character concepts, then we would love to work with you!

title: Facility Operations Manager - Próspera
description:
Position Summary

As the Facility Operations Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring the optimal functioning of our properties. You will organize and build a high-performing team, establish and maintain systems and processes, track and report on financials, and be accountable for the overall cleanliness, safety, and efficiency of our facilities. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of attracting and retaining top talent, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to operate efficiently while maintaining exceptional standards.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Team Leadership & Management

    • Recruit, hire, and retain A-player maintenance, cleaning, and landscaping staff.

    • Provide consistent coaching, performance feedback, and professional development opportunities to ensure strong team engagement and minimal turnover.

    • Establish a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement across all staff.

  2. Operational Oversight

    • Develop, implement, and refine systems and processes to ensure efficient day-to-day operations of all facilities.

    • Schedule and oversee routine and preventative maintenance to ensure facilities operate at the highest standard.

    • Manage third-party vendors and service providers as needed, ensuring quality and cost-effectiveness.

  3. Financial Management & Reporting

    • Track operational expenses and manage department budgets, ensuring compliance with financial targets.

    • Bill appropriate cost centers accurately and maintain transparent financial reporting.

    • Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities without compromising service quality or safety.

  4. Facility Maintenance & Safety

    • Maintain safe working conditions and ensure compliance with local regulations.

    • Develop and implement emergency response and evacuation procedures.

    • Monitor and improve the security, cleanliness, and aesthetics of all facilities through clear standards and regular inspections.

  5. Continuous Improvement

    • Implement best-in-class facilities management practices, embracing technology and innovation where beneficial.

    • Measure and report on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to continuously improve service levels and operational efficiencies.

    • Stay current on industry trends, tools, and techniques to ensure our facilities are managed at an exceptional level.

  6. Stakeholder Communication

    • Serve as the primary liaison between facilities operations and other departments or leadership teams.

    • Provide clear, regular updates on facilities projects, budgets, and operational status to management and relevant stakeholders.

    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to anticipate and address facilities-related needs.

Qualifications

  • Education & Experience

    • Proven leadership experience with a demonstrated ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent.

  • Skills & Competencies

    • Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

    • Strong financial acumen, with the ability to create and manage budgets, monitor cost centers, and analyze spending.

    • Demonstrated knowledge of safety and regulatory compliance.

    • Adept at implementing systems, processes, and technology solutions that streamline facility operations.

    • Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative and team-oriented approach.

    • Proactive problem-solver with a keen attention to detail and high standards for quality and performance.

Why Join Us?

  • Impact & Autonomy: Lead a team that directly influences the comfort, safety, and well-being of our entire organization.

  • Growth & Development: We foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development, offering ample opportunities for advancement.

  • Collaborative Environment: Join a supportive, dynamic team committed to excellence, innovation, and operational efficiency.

Know someone that might be a fit for this role?

Earn $2,000 by referring them to this job. As long as they work for us for at least 3 months and they add your name & phone number to the “Referred By” field when they submit their application, you’ll earn the bonus.

title: Director of Development
description:
We are NO Longer accepting applications at this time. Thank you for your interest!

Position Level: Director

Hours: 30-40 per week, depending on your preference. We offer full benefits (including health care) for everyone working 30 hours or more.

Pay: $80-$100K annually for 40 hours per week; $60-$75K annually for 30 hours per week.

If you are currently in an executive-level fundraising role, we encourage you to apply. We are open to discussing adjustments to the role’s scope and compensation, based on your expertise and experience.

Location: US Remote. We have a small office in Brooklyn, NY, but we mainly work remotely in various time zones. You must be located in the United States, ideally near a city. 

Additional Details: To dive deeper into our mission, values, and what success looks like in this role, check out our blog post. This overview shares our growth, culture, and key metrics. So you'll know how to thrive on our team.

Apply: If you wish to apply, please submit your Resume (PDF format) here, where you can also learn more about our process and benefits on our website. Please keep your resume to 2 pages maximum.

—————————

ABOUT THE ADVENTURE PROJECT

The Adventure Project creates jobs that empower entire communities to work their own way out of extreme poverty, for good.

The Adventure Project partners with local ventures in Africa to create jobs. These jobs help people escape extreme poverty while tackling the core issues of Health, Hunger, Water, and Climate. By focusing on sustainable solutions, we ensure lasting change for women, children, and entire communities. Fueled by a dedicated community of givers, we provide transparent proof of impact at every step, so people can see the difference they are making.

Over the last 14 years, The Adventure Project has created over 2.8K jobs, impacting 2.9M+ lives. Our vision is to create 100K jobs that meet the essential needs of 50M people by 2030. This position will be critical to leading and contributing to our long-term growth strategy. Learn more about our 2024 impact here.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Director of Development, you'll harness your expertise to build a world-changing development team from the ground up.

The ideal candidate has 8+ years of experience. You must have built and managed relationships with a range of stakeholders, from Executive Board Members to first-time supporters. You’ll be a master storyteller, sharing the transformative impact of our work in ways that energize, inspire, and deeply connect with our community. The candidate will report directly to our co-founder and CEO, Becky Straw.

This is a position where you will be valued as a key leader and strategic partner in shaping our growth. We’re looking for a strong performer in this role to advance to an executive-level position. 

If you’ve been dreaming of a role where your passion, creativity, and vision can shine, this is it. 

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

Fundraising & Supporter Engagement

  • Grow Individual Giving: Build and maintain relationships with key supporters. Engage them personally to maximize their giving.

  • Build Corporate & Foundation Partnerships: Develop and manage relationships with corporate partners and foundations to secure sponsorships, grants, and other opportunities. 

  • Lead our Women’s Fund: Grow and manage our Women's Fund, which invests in female-founded, local organizations in Africa. Led by The Catbird Foundation, this fund addresses the troubling fact that only 2% of funding goes to women and girls.

  • Launch our Legacy Giving Campaign: Design and implement our first Legacy Giving campaign, launching in the summer of 2025. 

  • Holiday Giving Campaign: Help design and craft holiday giving for major supporters, including setting targets, securing matching gifts, and supporting direct mail and gratitude reports. 

Materials Development

  • Pitch Materials: Work with the team to create proposals, presentations, one-pagers, and tailored pitch decks for donors, corporate partners, and other stakeholders.

  • Supporter Communications: Write and send impact reports. Build strong ties with supporters, foundations, and corporate partners.

  • Strategic Planning and Budgeting: Set fundraising targets and annual budgets. 

Event Planning & Execution

  • Fundraising Events: Help plan and run 3-4 intimate fundraising events each year. These are typically cocktail events or small house parties. You will have administrative support.

  • Anniversary Celebration: While annual galas aren’t our thing, 2025 marks our 15th anniversary. You will help lead our 15th-anniversary celebration in Fall 2025 in NYC. 

  • Supporter Field Trips: Plan and run 1-2 trips a year to program sites for key supporters.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years of fundraising experience, ideally in the social sector (nonprofits, foundations, social enterprises). Experience building donor relationships through one-on-one engagement, with a strong track record of converting major gifts.

  • Experience using and optimizing CRM tools - preferably Salesforce to guide fundraising strategies, identify new growth opportunities, and manage critical donor touch points.

  • Experienced communicator with the ability to share our mission and win others over (WOO!). 

  • Travel Requirements: We value our relationships with supporters, and encourage occasional in-person connections with donors who have an outsized impact on our work. This may include 1-2 annual international trips to show key supporters our work.

KEY SKILLS

  • Collaboration & Communication. You work effectively with others to reach common goals.

  • Entrepreneurial Spirit. You take the initiative to deepen relationships and forge new ones.

  • Strategic Thinking. You think strategically about building scalable systems and feel confident leveraging our brand, assets, relationships, and opportunities to meet growth targets.

  • Data-Driven. You have a keen understanding of the key metrics, tools, and software necessary to drive great CRM. You also follow the data. You love to try new ideas, but you also believe it’s important to track results and follow where the data leads you.

  • Passion for ending extreme poverty through job creation. You believe in our model and can speak confidently about international, sustainable development.

  • Ownership: You thrive on taking charge of projects and driving strong results. You aren't afraid to delegate, strategize, and solve problems. You want every task to be completed and to exceed expectations.

  • Curiosity: You have an insatiable drive to uncover insights. When you see data or results, your first instinct is to ask, "Why?" You love exploring and experimenting. You want to find better ways to achieve your goals.

  • Experienced: You must have a history of securing gifts from individuals, corporations, and foundations. This role requires a seasoned professional. You must have worked in development, sales, or a similar role. 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Annual Salary: $80-$100K, for a 40-hour/week employee. $60-$75K annually for 30 hours per week. The final salary will be dependent on experience and hours.

  • Hours: 30-40 hours/week, depending on your preference.

  • ​​Working hours: We embrace flexible working. Let us know what hours empower you to be at your best both professionally and personally, and we’ll find a match for you and us.

  • Paid Time Off: 15 Vacation Days (prorated from date of hire); 11 Federal Holidays; 5 Sick Days (prorated from date of hire)

  • Parental Leave

  • Access to full benefits (healthcare, vision, dental), for U.S. employees working 30+ hours/week.

  • 401(k) and match

  • Professional Development 

  • Apple Laptop

We create good jobs around the world, so we believe you should have a good job, too. 

The Adventure Project is an equal-opportunity employer, and does not discriminate in its selection and employment practices. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, age, or other legally protected characteristics.

If you wish to apply, please submit your Resume (PDF format) here, where you can also learn more about our process and benefits on our website.

Due to the high volume of applicants, some phone or email inquiries may not receive a response. All applicants will receive an update as decisions are made. 

More key details

To dive deeper into our mission, values, and what success looks like in this role, check out our blog post: Read More Here. This overview shares our growth, culture, and key metrics. So you'll know how to thrive on our team.

title: Lead Editor (Freelance)
description:
Grizzle is an organic content marketing agency that helps enterprise and scaleup SaaS companies create and distribute quality content. Our clients include Semrush, Pipedrive, Web.com, Nextiva, ConnectWise, and Tide.

We’re a fully remote team dedicated to helping our clients achieve their goals and nurturing the best content and marketing talent in the B2B space. We want to empower you to do your best work and become the top 1% in your craft. There’s no progression ceiling here—many Grizzle alumni have joined us as junior editors and become Heads of Content and marketing superstars.

About the role:

We’re looking for talented freelance content marketing editors to work with us on an ongoing basis.

We’ll provide you with an interesting roster of clients, processes and playbooks to empower you to edit at the top of your game, and ongoing support from our editorial team.

As an agency, we take the time to create high-quality content that’s full of unique insights and value-adds. We’re not trying to replicate what’s already out there—anyone can do that. Every piece of content must have a purpose. If an audience isn’t blown away by our content, we haven’t done our job properly.

What you’ll be doing:

You’ll be editing ~10 to 15 pieces of content per week, depending on length, with access to copy editors and content coordinators to help you bring content to life.

Specifically, you’ll be:

  • Conducting developmental edits for blog posts, landing pages, original research pieces, email content, and more

  • Copy editing to ensure every sentence packs a punch and moves the narrative forward (proofreading, fact-checking, improving on-page SEO, etc.)

  • Offering editorial support to clients as part of our advisory services

  • Coaching writers by offering detailed feedback with a “show, don’t tell” approach

  • Creating and updating client content guidelines based on feedback

  • Contributing to the writer recruitment and onboarding process

  • Ensuring clients experience delightful and white-glove experiences

About you:

We’re looking for editors who:

  • Have excellent attention to detail, and can communicate consistently and work to deadlines

  • Can write in a clear and concise manner, and enjoy polishing content to perfection

  • Are able to work at a rapid pace to meet fluctuating client demands

  • Can think strategically and critically with a strong grasp of marketing and SEO principles

  • Feel fulfilled by coaching and helping writers grow

  • Recognize what separates original content from the crowd

Benefits of working with us:

If our mission aligns with your values, here are a few other benefits of joining our team:

  • Learn about content marketing and organic growth

  • Work with cool companies in interesting industries

  • Collaborate with top content marketing talent

  • Long-term and reliable retainer

We work on a fixed-rate per-project basis, starting at $150 per project. These don’t include client revisions, which have a separate fixed rate.

For ad-hoc editorial tasks, our hourly rate starts at $55 to $65.

title: Mechanical Engineer - Propulsion System Development
description:
Propulsion Development Engineer

About us:

At GATE Space, we develop green, chemical in-space propulsion solutions for the NewSpace economy. Drawing on years of experience developing rocket engines, our team is chasing the dream of a thriving economy in space and tackling space engineering problems with a rapid prototyping philosophy. We focus on the development of two products: The GATE Jetpack – a plug-and-play mobility solution for satellite missions – and the GATE Thruster – the world’s first chemical propulsion system capable of highly responsive deep throttling and differential thrust stabilization.

At GATE Space, we are committed to workforce diversity, equality and inclusion. We want to build a diverse team and welcome and value all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

About your role:

As a Mechanical Engineer at GATE Space, you will be responsible for advancing our thruster and propulsion systems, focusing on design and analysis of mechanical components, structures and mechanisms. You’ll play a key role in mechanical and thermal design, including close cooperation with parts manufacturing, while applying your numerical analysis expertise to optimize the structural and thermal design. This versatile role requires relevant work experience and offers the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge propulsion development in a fast-paced environment, supporting the whole development lifecycle.

Your primary tasks:

  • Development and design of thruster components and propulsion systems

  • Take ownership of the structural and thermal design

  • Conduct numerical mechanical and thermal analysis to verify designs and establish test predictions

  • Apply internal standards in accordance with industry standards

  • Contribute to customer projects as part of the project team 

  • Cooperate with the propulsion development, manufacturing as well as assembly, integration and testing team

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, , or a related field.

  • Industry experience of at least one year (or multiple years in a leading role of a student rocketry team liquid propulsion development) in as many of the following areas:

    • Experience in lightweight design of structures and mechanisms.

    • Experience in design and management of large assemblies.

    • Experience in CAD tools (e.g. Siemens NX).

    • Experience in mechanical and thermal numerical analysis.

    • Experience in numerical analysis tools (e.g. Ansys).

    • Experience in design for manufacturing and testing.

    • Experience in working in project teams.

    • [Optional but desired] Practical experience in manufacturing and assembly of mechanical systems. 

    • [Optional but desired] Experience in developing space hardware.

    • [Optional but desired] Familiarity with industry regulations and standards for space applications.

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.

  • In-depth knowledge of spacecraft propulsion, navigation, and control systems.

  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to evolving priorities.

About your employment

We are looking for a full-time employee, starting as soon as possible. This role is in-person in Vienna, Austria with occasional travel to customers all across Europe & the US as well as conferences and industry events globally.

About your benefits

  • First row seat in the development and implementation of space missions

  • Opportunity to shape a fast-growing space technology company

  • Attractive compensation package of €48,000 gross per year (exceeding compensation depending on qualifications)

  • Employee stock option bonus program making sure you benefit when the company grows 

  • Other perks such as free lunch at the office every day, free public transit ticket, etc.

  • Flexible working time arrangements

Join us in shaping the future of in-space mobility. If you're excited about pioneering technology, passionate about space exploration, and driven by business growth, apply now to become a key member of our dynamic team at GATE Space. Together, we'll enable the next generation of space travel and exploration.

title: Senior Protocol Lead
description:
Unlock the next era of public blockchain networks

About us 
We’re building Predicate, a platform setting the standard for how regulated blockchain applications enforce transaction rules at the smart contract layer. Predicate empowers teams to create modular, programmable policies—such as AML/CFT checks or offchain collateral requirements—that are verified before a transaction executes onchain. Our system enforces these policies with cryptographic guarantees, providing robust, scalable risk management tailored to real-world use cases.

The role 

As Protocol Lead, you’ll own the design, development, and maintenance of Predicate’s onchain suite. You’ll build tooling to support integrations, contribute to core infrastructure, and research emerging technologies to keep us at the forefront of the industry. You’ll also serve as the team’s blockchain subject matter expert, supporting teammates across the stack on all things related to blockchain interactions.

Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture, development, and maintenance of Predicate’s core smart contracts

  • Support customers integrating Predicate at the smart contract level

  • Deeply understand and add Predicate support for non-EVM chains

  • Iterate on the Predicate SDK and relevant documentation to supply a strong integration experience

  • Collaborate with the rest of the engineering team in Go and TypeScript on blockchain facing technology

What we look for

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering

  • 2+ years of experience in Solidity development

  • Deep familiarity with the Solidity, Rust, and other relevant emerging tools

  • Strong familiarity with Golang and/or Typescript

  • Strong communication skills and comfort working with external partners/customers

  • Curiosity, initiative, and a drive to ship high-quality systems

Perks

  • Unlimited PTO with a high level of autonomy for your work

  • Best-in-class health, dental and vision insurance

  • Bi-annually world-wide team offsites

Compensation

We are committed to hiring the best talent, and that is reflected in our salary, equity compensation, and culture.

title: Software Engineer, Backend
description:
About Superform

Superform is the user-owned neobank. We let anyone save, earn, swap, and spend capital directly onchain, without custodians, opaque intermediaries, or banks.

Our platform includes:

  • Superform Protocol: A permissionless smart account layer that compresses actions across chains into a single signature.

  • Superform App: Desktop, iOS, and Android apps that make the protocol accessible through consumer-grade UX.

  • SuperVaults: Institutional-grade, validator-secured vaults that dynamically optimize across fixed and variable rate strategies for USD, BTC, and ETH.

Superform is live across multiple chains, trusted with $130M+ in TVL, 160k+ depositors, and over two years of production uptime with zero exploits. We’re backed by leading investors across TradFi and DeFi, including VanEck, Circle, and Polychain.

With Superform v2 now live on desktop and mobile launches imminent, we’re looking to expand the backend engineering team foundation.

🌐 Website | 📱 App |

The Role

We’re hiring a Backend Engineer to be a swiss army knife across the Superform team, contributing to everything from production-grade Go microservices to the strategy behind a new SuperVault launch. You’ll join a tight team where every line of code ships to thousands of users and millions in assets. Each engineer is a multiplier and you will influence product vision, tech choices, and culture from day one.

What You’ll Do

  • Build systems for institutions to create and manage their own SuperVaults.

  • Design and implement APIs, services, and data pipelines that connect the Superform app to onchain infrastructure in real-time.

  • Collaborate with researchers to improve strategy performance, automate re-balancing, and implement ERC-4337 / ERC-7579 account abstraction flows.

  • Maintain high reliability standards (monitoring, alerting, incident response).

  • Contribute to code reviews, architecture decisions, and team-wide engineering practices.

Who You Are

  • Live and breathe DeFi. ERC-4626 vaults, ERC-7540, ERC‑4337 bundlers, ERC‑7579 smart accounts, ERC-7683 bridges, these are all things you’ve already had direct experience with.

  • Self-starter. You thrive in fast-moving, high-autonomy environments.

  • Design systems that scale 0→1 and 1→10 and know when to kill a proof of concept.

  • Treat tests, monitoring, and post-mortems as first-class engineering work.

  • Communicate early, often, and clearly.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent real-world mastery.

  • Production experience with:

    • Go

    • SQL & scalable data stores (Postgres, ClickHouse, Dagster)

  • Native fluency with blockchain concepts and tooling: vault products, subgraphs, JSON-RPC/Web3 libraries, basic Solidity comprehension.

  • Ability to overlap 09:00-13:00 ET (13:00-17:00 UTC) for stand-ups and pair sessions.

  • Comfort meeting Service-Level-Agreement (SLA) targets. 24 × 7 uptime is table stakes.

Nice to Have

  • Asset management or other traditional finance experience.

  • Deep expertise in on-chain data indexing or real-time market data feeds.

  • Prior work with account abstraction (ERC-4337) or smart-contract wallets.

  • Experience scaling high-volume financial exchanges, HFT systems, or DeFi protocols.

  • Belief in aliens 👽

title: Housekeeper - Buena Vista
description:
Independent Contractor | Piece Rate | Weekly Pay

Are you looking for a way to earn extra income on weekends?
Renjoy is seeking reliable and detail-oriented Independent Contractors to help clean and reset beautiful short-term rental homes in Buena Vista, primarily in the South Main area.

Mission Statement: PURPOSE
Deliver an exceptional, guest-ready clean at every Renjoy property in the Buena Vista market. You are the last line of quality before a guest walks through the door — your work directly determines the review they leave and the experience they remember. In a small, remote market, every cleaner carries significant weight. Precision, reliability, and ownership are non-negotiable.

3 OBSESSIONS
Every room must look, feel, and smell spotless — no exceptions, no shortcuts.
Follow the checklist and standard operating procedures every single clean.
Report issues, damages, lost-and-found items, and low supplies immediately upon discovery.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
Cleaning & Turnover
Complete full departure cleans between guest stays according to the Renjoy departure clean checklist.
Launder, fold, and stage all linens and towels to presentation standards.
Restock consumable supplies (toiletries, paper products, coffee) to property par levels.
Ensure all furniture, decor, and amenities are reset to their designated positions.
Verify all windows, doors, and locks are secure before departing the property.

Quality & Inspections
Self-inspect all spaces against the Renjoy quality checklist before marking a clean complete.
Photograph any damage, maintenance issue, or guest-left item and report immediately via SuiteOp.
Accept and respond constructively to quality inspections and scoring feedback.
Flag any property condition (appliance, fixture, lock, safety item) that does not meet standard.

Communication & Reporting
Receive task assignments and updates through SuiteOp — check the app before each clean.
Communicate directly with the Head of Homes (BV) for scheduling changes, supply needs, or property issues.
Report lost-and-found items with photos and property details on the same day of discovery.
Provide an accurate completion time when a clean is finished so operations can confirm guest readiness.

Supplies & Inventory
Maintain awareness of supply levels at each assigned property and proactively flag shortages.
Pick up supplies from the designated BV storage location as directed.
Never substitute unapproved products — use only Renjoy-approved cleaning products and consumables.

BUENA VISTA MARKET — WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW
The BV market operates as a small, tight-knit team in a remote mountain environment. Unlike our Colorado Springs operation, there is no large support staff nearby. That means each cleaner carries more individual accountability — you are expected to be proactive, self-directed, and communicative without daily in-person oversight.
Properties include mountain homes and condos in and around Buena Vista — some with hot tubs, outdoor furniture, and seasonal considerations.
Weather and road conditions can affect schedules; reliability and advance communication are critical.
You will coordinate directly with the Head of Homes for all scheduling, supply, and issue escalation.
Task management and completion confirmation occur through SuiteOp — not text or phone.

Compensation & Perks

  • Competitive piece-rate pay

  • Weekly direct deposit

  • Flexible scheduling

  • Work locally — no long commutes

Location: Buena Vista & surrounding areas
Compensation: Piece rate ($50–$150 per clean)
Start Date: ASAP

Job Type: Contract

Experience:

  • Commercial cleaning: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Founding Head of Growth • PLG, Demand Gen, & Ads.
description:

title: Webflow Developer (LATAM & North America, Remote)
description:
Overview

We’re 8020 — We help companies + creators like Wave, Vanta, Superlist, Pilot.com, Huberman Lab, Hasan Minhaj, Alltrue, Helix (Q2), and many more move faster without code. Whether they’re a seed-stage startup or a publicly-traded enterprise, brands around the world every day rely on 8020 to design, develop, and launch the internet's most ambitious websites.

About This Opening

We're seeking a talented Webflow Developer to join temporarily our remote team at 8020. With a strong reputation in the industry, we’re offering the chance to contribute to forward-thinking Webflow projects for some of the largest names on the internet. As part of a collaborative team, you can work alongside exceptional project managers, designers, and senior developers, creating an environment that encourages personal and professional development.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience: You're an experienced developer with at least 2 years of Webflow experience and a portfolio of past work to showcase. You have a strong track record of delivering successful Webflow sites in business settings.

  • Efficient: You're comfortable using a development framework like Mast or similar frameworks, and constantly seek opportunities to improve your workflow + speed.

  • Communicative: You excel in asynchronous communication through written channels (Slack, ClickUp) or video (Loom) and consistently engage with teammates and clients. You communicate clearly and professionally in English — both in writing and on video calls. You'll regularly collaborate with native English speakers, including clients, so confident spoken English is important.

  • Methodical: Whether writing code snippets or developing complete websites for clients, you meticulously ensure semantic, performant, and optimized deliverables that drive client success. You rigorously test and review your work before deploying it to production.

  • Proactive: During periods of free time, you proactively identify and engage in side projects that align with company objectives, enabling skill growth.

What You'll Do

  • Figma to Webflow: You'll primarily collaborate with our design team or clients, translating design files (often in Figma) into dynamic, visually appealing websites.

  • Perform Audits: We often begin retainer or replatforming projects with a comprehensive audit to identify high-impact opportunities for our partners. You will need to evaluate websites from several perspectives including SEO, accessibility, and performance, and translate your findings into clear and strategic recommendations.

  • Retainer Services: In some cases, you'll collaborate closely with clients on an ongoing basis, serving as an extension of their team. Retainer work necessitates exceptional communication skills and the ability to foster strong relationships.

  • Be a Good Partner: At 8020, we pride ourselves on being an exceptional and trusted partner to our clients. We approach decision-making as if we were owners of their businesses and rely on you to assist clients in making strategic choices for their success.

  • Migrations: You have experience supporting website migrations, including organizing and mapping large sets of content. You are comfortable working with Airtable or similar tools to structure data, and you understand Webflow’s CMS capabilities well enough to propose clear and scalable ways to manage that data during and after the migration.

Where You'll Do It‍

This is a remote-first position open to candidates anywhere in the Americas — North, Central, or South America. Candidates in US, Canadian, Latin American, or Caribbean time zones are all warmly welcome.

Significant preference will be given to candidates available to overlap with US Central time during core working hours.

‍Who Will Be Prioritized

  • Developers with a proven track record of successfully collaborating with clients or stakeholders in professional environments.

  • Developers with proficiency in Webflow's underlying code output: HTML, CSS, and basic Javascript. (If you have moderate-to-advanced proficiency in writing Javascript or JQuery, we recommend noting it in your application.)

  • Developers demonstrating excellent verbal and written communication skills, along with a willingness to teach and simplify complex concepts.

  • Developers with experience working in client service, either within an agency or as a freelancer.

  • Webflow developer with experience with MAST

  • Developers who actively integrate AI tools into their workflow and are familiar with or curious about the Webflow MCP (Model Context Protocol).

‍Who This Job Isn’t For

  • In line with our core values, you can't be an asshole. Life is short.

  • We love it when our team can find ways to self-improve, even in downtime. If you need clear tasks assigned to you at all times, this may not be the role for you.‍

  • Attention to detail is a cornerstone of our work ethos. If you tend to overlook details, you might find this role challenging.

  • 8020 is — in many ways — still a startup. We make decisions on the fly and sometimes have to course-correct as we go. In line with our core value of Prioritizing Momentum, you may find it difficult to work here if you need every single question answered before you can move forward on a task.

title: Software Engineer Enablement
description:
At Carbon Re, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like Cement, steel and glass), by applying cutting-edge AI where it matters most.

We’re a small and growing team of scientists, engineers, strategic thinkers and implementers who care deeply about impact and believe in getting there with good humour and a healthy dose of urgency. Our first SaaS product helps cement producers optimise their operations in real time, cutting costs and carbon today while building foundational AI for the next industrial revolution.

With Carbon Re, you’ll do something that actually helps the planet. Not a bad way to invest your career.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our platform team and help us push the boundaries of what AI can do for the planet.

We don’t draw a specific line between engineering and research teams. We operate as one cohesive unit, sharing tech stack, knowledge, and objectives. Our focus spans from fundamental ML research to commercial-grade software development, offering diverse learning and impact opportunities.

Your main responsibilities

  • Talk to colleagues about their work, the processes they follow, and the roadblocks they face.

  • Propose, design, build and document robust software systems to meet those needs.

  • Assist more junior team members with their learning and explain how things work.

  • Deliver pragmatic solutions that balance short-term delivery with long-term maintainability.

What a great fit looks like

  • You’re fluent in Python and Terraform.

  • You are excited about building internal tooling and CI/CD.

  • You’ve worked in a cloud environment; bonus points for Google Cloud expertise.

  • You love to collaborate with others and are familiar with agile technical practices, including pair programming, mobbing and TDD.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy owning a problem from discovery to delivery.

You’ll excel if

  • You are seeking a role in climate tech, or tech for good.

  • You have a genuine interest in machine learning and the physical sciences.

  • You have opinions about how to build robust model deployment platforms.

You are not expected to check every box, and we’d love to hear from you even if your experience isn’t an exact match.

We’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Our people come from all walks of life - different countries, cultures and experiences - and we think that’s one of our biggest strengths. We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected and celebrated. No matter your background, if you’re excited by what we do, we want to hear from you.

In return for your hard work, we’ll give you

  • 💸 A competitive salary

    £75-90k

  • 📈 Equity in the company

    When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside.

  • 🕰️ Flexible working

    We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team.

  • 🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays)

    Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge

  • 🪙 A generous pension scheme

    We’re planning for the future in more ways than one.

The interview process

We run a 4-stage process for engineers after the initial short screening call to confirm alignment on role expectations, experience, and next steps.

  1. Pair programming: you’ll meet with one of our other engineers to work on a toy problem together. You can use Google or LLMs, or you can ask your pair for help. We want to know what you’re like to work with, how you approach solving problems in an unfamiliar space, and how you communicate about code.

  2. Whiteboard session - you’ll meet with two of our engineers. We’ll ask you to draw a diagram of a system you’re familiar with and walk us through its major architectural components. We’ll ask questions about the decisions you made, and the things you like and dislike. We want to know how well you understand the technologies you use, and how you communicate about complex technical matters.

  3. Operating principles: You’ll meet with some people from other parts of the business. We’ll ask you questions to understand how you would work in a culture governed by our operating principles.

  4. Meet the CEO - before we make an offer, we’d like to schedule a 15-minute chat with Josh, our CEO.

We believe hiring is a two-way process. Just as we’ll reference-check candidates before making a final offer, we encourage you to reference-check us by chatting with team members you haven’t yet met. Ask anything. We’ll answer with Concrete Honestly.

Once interviews are done, we’ll move quickly to a decision, and we’re always happy to give feedback at any stage.

Our operating principles

We’re building a workplace that’s ambitious, kind, and a little bit different. Somewhere you can do your best work alongside people you respect and enjoy being around. Our operating principles help guide how we show up every day:

🏭 Concrete Honesty

Say it how it is. Our honesty is strong, foundational, and built to last.

📈 Forever Optimising

We’re in the business of constantly tweaking, testing and improving.

⏩ Increase Torque

We move with urgency because the climate crisis won’t wait.

🔧 Maintain Reliability

We build trust by showing up, following through, and having each other’s backs.

😄 Cement It with Fun & Kindness

We’re here to extend Earth’s life, but ours is still limited. Let’s enjoy it and be good to each other while we do.

To see these in full, go to Carbon Re’s Operating Principles Notion page.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:

We combine architectural expertise with software, automation, and data systems to dramatically accelerate how projects move from land acquisition to approved designs and construction. Our team blends architects, engineers, and product builders. We design real buildings — and we build the software systems that make great architecture scalable.

title: Scientist to Senior Scientist, Molecular Biology
description:
Title: Scientist to Senior Scientist, Molecular Biology (m/f/d)

Location: 100% on site, Heidelberg/Munich

Contract: Full time 

Position summary:

Kano is building next-generation genome engineering technologies to enable transformative cell-based therapies. Our platform leverages proprietary circular single-stranded DNA (cssDNA) donor technology to unlock precise, efficient, and scalable genomic insertions. By integrating advances in gene editing, immunology, and cell engineering, Kano is advancing discovery programs at the intersection of immuno-oncology and genetic medicine.

As an early-stage team, Kano offers a highly collaborative and dynamic research environment where scientists have the opportunity to take ownership of impactful projects from concept through execution. Team members work cross-functionally to develop innovative solutions, apply cutting-edge molecular and cellular biology techniques, and translate scientific insights into therapeutic strategies. This role is ideal for a driven scientist who thrives in a fast-paced setting and is motivated to push the boundaries of genome engineering and cell therapy.


Responsibilities:

  • Work both independently and as part of a team to design, execute and optimize genomic insertion analysis in primary human cells and cell lines using Kano’s proprietary circular ssDNA donor technology

  • Detect gene editing outcomes using a variety of methods including flow cytometry, digital PCR, NGS and others as appropriate

  • Design and produce test constructs to support high-throughput screening efforts, including cloning of plasmids, manufacturing and handling of mRNA, and guide RNA design. 

  • Design, execute, and interpret experiments with molecular biology techniques 

  • Design and optimize fit for purpose analytical methods, including for identification of genomic insertions and subcellular localization of nucleic acids.

  • Conduct literature and intellectual property reviews and aid in the ideation of potential projects 

  • Write protocols, prepare data presentations for company-wide meetings, maintain a highly organized and detailed electronic laboratory notebook (ELN) and stay up to date with scientific literature

  • Handle multiple projects effectively, prioritizing tasks, collaborate across teams with ease

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of professional research experience or PhD in Immunology, Biology, Cell Biology or related fields

  • Demonstrated experience with CRISPR-based genome editing assay development and interpretation

  • Experience in molecular cloning techniques for plasmid generation, including PCR, Gibson assembly, restriction cloning, Golden gate assembly, and library generation

  • Expertise with a variety of molecular and cell biology techniques such as DNA/RNA/protein extraction, sequencing, PCR, ddPCR, ELISA, and western blot

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, navigates easily working with researchers from all levels of training

  • Fluency in spoken and written English is required
